Seedance 2.0 Video Prompt:

The entire video has almost no spoken dialogue — just gentle background music, extremely detailed ambient sounds (water trickling, bamboo creaking, fire crackling, birds, wind, cooking noises, soft laughter), and a few very short child voices saying things like “Mama” or “Wow.” It’s 100 % focused on calming sensory experiences.Story / What happens in the video (scene-by-scene flow)The video follows a single peaceful summer day in a rural stilt-house village:Opening – Hot, still summer morning
You see the traditional wooden stilt house (nhà sàn) surrounded by lush green mountains and a stream. The air feels hot and quiet.
Mother builds the bamboo water wheel
A loving mother carefully crafts a large, traditional bamboo water wheel (guồng nước) by the stream using only natural bamboo, vines, and simple tools.
You watch every step of the slow, satisfying craftsmanship: cutting bamboo, tying pieces, testing the wheel in the water. This is the main “building” part and feels very meditative.
Installing the bamboo water line
Once the wheel is finished and spinning with the stream’s current, she connects a long bamboo pipe/aqueduct system that carries cool water all the way up to and around the stilt house. Water starts flowing gently through the bamboo channels.
Kids playing with the water
Children (her kids) excitedly run under the bamboo spout. You see them laughing, splashing, and enjoying the cool water on a hot day. There are sweet, wholesome family moments here.
Cooling off & daily life
Scenes of simple village life: bathing or washing with the fresh stream water, the house now surrounded by the gentle sound of flowing water.
Cozy family cooking & dinner
The mother prepares a traditional meal in the open kitchen area of the stilt house:  Five-color sticky rice (xôi ngũ sắc)
Grilled stream fish
Herbal tea
Sweet dumplings
The cooking is shown in very detailed, slow ASMR style (fire sounds, chopping, sizzling, steam, etc.).

prompts.text: What if a museum diorama wasn’t just a display... but a doorway? #AKCB Seedance 2 Prompt 👇 Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic movie-style video. CHARACTER: IMG_17 is the main character. He wears a black balaclava with no visible mouth or nose. Preserve his proportions, wardrobe, materials, silhouette, and identity through every scale change. Do not redesign, humanize, or reveal facial features. STYLE: Photoreal cinematic realism with surreal museum magic. Handheld camera, slight natural shake, shallow depth of field, soft motion blur, realistic exposure shifts, subtle film grain, believable body physics. No on-screen text, subtitles, captions, logos, or dialogue. SETTING: INT. QUIET MUSEUM GALLERY – DAY. A large glass display case holds a detailed historical battlefield diorama: tiny hills, miniature soldiers, broken stone walls, flags, horses, cannons, dust, grass, and dramatic painted background scenery. Warm museum spotlights, soft shadows, floating dust particles. The museum feels real, but the diorama becomes a living world. SINGLE CONTINUOUS SHOT, no hard cuts. Camera follows dynamically. 0–2s: IMG_17 stands beside the glass display case, looking at the miniature battlefield diorama inside. Museum lights reflect on the glass. A tiny flag inside the diorama suddenly moves although there is no wind. IMG_17 leans closer. 2–4s: The glass surface ripples softly like invisible water. IMG_17 reaches toward it and is suddenly pulled forward. His body presses through the glass without breaking it. Scale snap: IMG_17 becomes miniature, now standing inside the battlefield diorama among giant grass blades, toy soldiers, stones, and dust. 4–6s: INSIDE THE DIORAMA WORLD. The tiny battlefield comes alive. Miniature soldiers remain statue-like, but the environment moves around them. Dust rolls like fog, flags snap in the wind, and a small horse statue cracks to life. IMG_17 runs across the uneven terrain as the camera tracks low beside him. 6–8s: The living miniature horse gallops past. IMG_17 jumps onto its back in one fast motion. Scale snap: he becomes proportional to the horse. The horse charges through the diorama between frozen soldiers, broken walls, tiny cannons, and painted hills. Camera orbits with motion blur and dramatic museum spotlight flashes. 8–10s: The horse leaps over a miniature cannon just as it bursts with a puff of harmless dust. IMG_17 holds tight. The diorama terrain tilts unnaturally like a museum model becoming a real battlefield. Painted background clouds seem to move for a moment. 10–12s: The horse races toward the curved glass wall of the display case. IMG_17 jumps from the horse toward the glass. He passes through the glass surface mid-air. Scale snap: IMG_17 returns to normal human size, bursting back into the museum gallery. 12–14s: IMG_17 lands hard on the polished museum floor. Knees bend, one hand touches the ground, a small dust puff rises. Behind him, the diorama instantly freezes again: horse statue still, soldiers motionless, flags stiff. The glass reflection settles. 14–15s: IMG_17 slowly stands, turns toward the camera, and gives a quick confident nod. The museum remains quiet, but inside the display case one tiny flag moves once more. AUDIO / MUSIC: Quiet museum ambience, soft footsteps, glass ripple sound, tiny battlefield wind, horse gallop, dust cannon puff, rising cinematic adventure music, then a brief heroic swell at the final nod.

prompts.text: “Use the attached CARL VS THE TREADMILL character sheet throughout. Carl is a Pixar 3D man, mid 40s, soft round build, neon yellow t-shirt, electric blue gym shorts, neon orange trainers, white sweatband on wrist and forehead. Full Pixar 3D render. No realistic humans. THE GYM: Bright modern gym. Colorful equipment, mirror walls, warm lighting. Bright red treadmill center frame with speed panel and emergency stop button visible. Several Pixar gym-goers in background. MUSIC: Upbeat cheerful music at start. Builds with Carl’s panic. Cuts to complete silence the moment he flies off. Dead silence to the end. 0:00–0:02 — Wide gym shot. Carl walks up confidently, sweatband crooked, sets speed way too high, steps on. Immediately something is wrong. SOUND: Cheerful music. Treadmill starting. 0:02–0:04 — Carl grabs handles. Reaches for speed button. Hits wrong button. Speed increases. Both hands back on handles. Eyes wide. Sweatband shifting. SOUND: Music picking up. Carl’s grunt. 0:04–0:07 — Wide shot. Full uncontrolled sprint. Neon shirt rippling, cheeks wobbling, sweatband sideways. Gym-goers in background stopping to watch. Carl holding on for his life. SOUND: Chaotic music. Treadmill roaring. Panicked breathing. 0:07–0:09 — Close on Carl’s face and hands scrambling across the panel. Hits emergency stop. Belt stops instantly. SOUND: Button press. Silence. 0:09–0:11 — Slow motion. Carl launches off the back. Electric blue shorts catch on the handle and pull clean off mid-air. Bright patterned boxers revealed. Carl slides across the floor on his back, neon trainers still on. SOUND: Slow motion whoosh. Fabric ripping. Silence on landing. 0:11–0:15 — Carl flat on the floor in boxers. Every gym-goer staring. Carl looks at his shorts hanging off the treadmill. Looks at his boxers. Puts his face on the floor. Does not get up. Treadmill unbothered. Shorts still hanging. Fade out. SOUND: Dead silence. Faint indifferent gym music returns. Fade out. Camera: wide gym, medium panel shot, wide sprint tracking, close face and hands, slow motion launch, wide floor shot, wide final. Bright vivid Pixar colors throughout.”

GPT Image 2 storyboard prompt:

“Create a Pixar 3D style character design sheet. Clean white background. Two characters side by side with a clean dividing line. Bold brushstroke-style title at the top: CARL vs THE TREADMILL. Subtitle beneath: One button. Wrong button. No pants.

LEFT SIDE — CARL
Large name in bold black. Underneath: “He just wanted a light jog.”

Hero portrait — Carl isolated on clean white. No background. Pixar 3D man, mid 40s, soft round build, slightly overweight in the most relatable way. Bright neon yellow t-shirt, electric blue gym shorts, neon orange trainers, white sweatband on his wrist, another on his forehead. The kind of gym outfit that says maximum effort with minimum results. Expression of pure misplaced confidence. Just Carl on white.

Three poses beneath:

- Stepping onto the treadmill, one finger on the speed dial, wide smile, sweatband already slightly crooked. This will be a light jog. He has decided.
- Full sprint, both hands gripping the handles white-knuckle, neon yellow shirt rippling, feet a total blur, eyes enormous, cheeks wobbling, sweatband now fully sideways. He cannot let go. He will never let go.
- Lying flat on the gym floor in bright patterned boxers, neon orange trainers still on, one arm out, sweatband somehow still on his head. Electric blue shorts hanging off the treadmill handle in the background. Every gym-goer staring. Carl’s face completely flat on the floor.

SPEED MANAGEMENT ░░░░░░░░░░ Set it too high then higher
GRIP STRENGTH ██████████ The only thing that saved him briefly
DIGNITY ░░░░░░░░░░ On the treadmill with the shorts

RIGHT SIDE — THE TREADMILL
Large name in bold black. Underneath: “It did exactly what he asked.”

Hero portrait — the treadmill isolated on clean white. Modern gym treadmill, bright red frame, black belt, digital speed display on the panel showing a very high number, emergency stop button clearly visible. Completely still. Completely unbothered. Just the treadmill on white.

Three poses beneath:

- Treadmill at rest. Speed display showing a very high number. Innocent. Waiting.
- Treadmill running at full speed — belt blurring. Carl’s electric blue shorts hanging off the side handle. Still going. Unbothered.
- Treadmill completely still. Emergency stop pressed. Carl gone. Shorts still hanging. No remorse.

SPEED SETTING ██████████ Whatever he asked for
REMORSE ░░░░░░░░░░ It is a treadmill. It has no opinion on Carl’s shorts.

BOTTOM STRIP — five cinematic panels bleeding into each other:
Carl’s confident finger on the speed dial, wide smile, sweatband already crooked · Carl’s white-knuckle hands on the handles, neon yellow shirt and blue shorts blurring with speed · Carl’s wide panicked face mid-sprint, cheeks wobbling, sweatband fully sideways · Carl flying off the back in slow motion, electric blue shorts catching on the handle pulling clean off, bright patterned boxers revealed mid-air · Carl flat on the gym floor in boxers, neon orange trainers still on, every gym-goer staring, blue shorts hanging off the treadmill behind him

THE SPEED WAS WRONG. THE BUTTON WAS WRONG. THE PANTS WERE COLLATERAL.

STYLE NOTES: Pixar 3D vivid rendering. Maximum brightness and color throughout — neon yellow, electric blue, neon orange. Bright modern gym in bottom strip panels — colorful equipment, mirror walls, warm lighting. Both hero portraits on clean white. Carl’s expressions at full Pixar exaggeration — misplaced confidence to full panic to hollow defeat. Treadmill bright red frame, identical and unbothered in every frame. Electric blue shorts hanging off the handle visible in final right side poses and last two bottom strip panels. Every frame saturated, vivid, energetic.”

Honestly, the difference in:

motion consistency

camera movement

choreography flow

cinematic weight

character realism

was way bigger than I expected.

Omni Flash isn’t bad, but side-by-side it still struggles with:

floaty motion

weak impact physics

inconsistent body movement

lower cinematic intensity

Suddenly — a massive hippo ERUPTS upward from the water right in front, mouth wide open. Louisiana bayou, late afternoon turning to dusk, golden-orange light reflecting off still water, Spanish moss hanging from cypress trees, thick humidity, insects in air, shallow muddy water with reeds and roots, narrow water channels.

⸻

Camera already mounted low on the side of an airboat, skimming fast across shallow swamp water. The prop engine ROARS loudly. Water sprays across lens. ⸻

⸻

Prompt below 👇 FORMAT: 10s · ultra cinematic sports realism · fast pacing · dynamic golf commercial energy SUBJECT: Professional golfer hitting a golf ball with a driver club during golden-hour sunlight on a massive championship golf course. Hyper-detailed golf ball, grass particles, cinematic athletic motion, realistic swing mechanics. CAMERA STYLE: Macro close-up → ultra-fast whip tracking → rear ball chase cam → aerial velocity tracking → low ground skim → hole reveal → impact finish. EFFECTS: Flying grass particles, dirt spray, realistic ball spin, sunlight glints on ball surface, motion compression, subtle lens vibration, speed ramps, dynamic depth blur. LIGHTING: Warm golden sunset lighting, dramatic long shadows, natural sunlight reflections, realistic sports-commercial contrast. AUDIO: Only realistic sound effects (SFX), no background music, no cinematic score, no music layers. Focus on natural environmental sounds and action-based audio only. 🎞️ TIMELINE 0:00–0:01 — BALL SETUP Extreme macro close-up of golf ball resting on tee. Driver club slowly enters frame beside the ball. Tiny grass blades moving in the wind. DIRECTOR NOTE: Create tension before impact using micro camera shake and shallow depth focus. (Camera: ultra-macro push-in with subtle handheld breathing) (SFX: distant wind, faint crowd ambience, glove adjustment) 0:01–0:02 — IMPACT The driver violently strikes the golf ball. Grass and dirt explode outward in slow-motion for a split second before speed ramps instantly. DIRECTOR NOTE: Make the impact feel explosive and powerful. (Camera: high-speed side impact shot → snap velocity ramp) (SFX: sharp club crack, dirt burst, air snap) 0:02–0:04 — BALL FLIGHT TRACKING Camera aggressively tracks directly behind the golf ball flying through the air at extreme speed above the course. Trees, bunkers, and fairway blur beneath. DIRECTOR NOTE: The viewer should feel attached to the ball mid-flight. (Camera: rear-follow chase cam with dynamic stabilization and micro vibration) (SFX: intense wind rush, distant birds) 0:04–0:06 — AERIAL SWEEP Camera swings around the spinning golf ball in mid-air while sunlight reflects dramatically across its surface. Huge golf course visible below. DIRECTOR NOTE: Add cinematic breathing space while maintaining speed. (Camera: fast aerial orbit with motion-compression effect) (SFX: fast air tearing, subtle spin whistle) 0:06–0:08 — DESCENT The ball rapidly drops toward the green. Camera skims inches above the grass tracking the descending ball as it bounces once and rolls aggressively toward the hole. DIRECTOR NOTE: Increase suspense before final payoff. (Camera: ultra-low ground tracking with realistic bounce shake) (SFX: grass impact, rolling friction, crowd gasp) 0:08–0:10 — FINAL SHOT The golf ball rolls perfectly into the hole from long distance. Tiny dirt particles shake around the cup. Camera quickly pushes toward the hole as the ball disappears inside. DIRECTOR NOTE: End with satisfying precision and clean payoff energy. (Camera: rapid push-in → centered hole reveal) (SFX: clean ball drop into cup, distant crowd eruption, soft wind fade)

prompts.text: Prompt Create a cinematic text-to-video scene featuring an original non-copyrighted moment where an elderly man watches alone from across the street as the factory where he worked for forty-one years is demolished in a controlled implosion he did not tell his family he was coming, could not explain why he needed to be there, and does not fully understand it himself. prompts.text: “Use the attached DAVE VS THE GOLF BALL character sheet as the exact visual reference for Dave throughout. Dave is a Pixar 3D man, mid 50s, slight dad build, bright red polo shirt, white golf glove on left hand, khaki golf trousers, white golf shoes, visor slightly crooked. Every character on the course — Dave, the hatless golfer, any background figures — full Pixar 3D render. No realistic humans. THE COURSE: Bright vivid golf course throughout. Deep green fairways, bright blue sky, golden sunlight, tall trees lining the fairway, colorful golf carts. Maximum brightness and color. No dark frames. THE BALL: Standard white golf ball with small red logo. Identical throughout. Camera follows it for most of the video. MUSIC: Calm pleasant golf music at the start — soft and relaxed. The moment the ball hits the tree at 0:02 the music shifts to a chaotic comedy track — fast bouncy horns following each ricochet. Returns to calm pleasant music the moment the ball drops in the hole at 0:10. 0:00–0:02 — Medium shot. Dave on the tee, composed, confident. Takes one slow deliberate swing. Perfect clean strike. Ball launches into the bright blue sky. Dave watches it fly, satisfied smile, club resting on his shoulder. SOUND: Clean club strike. Whoosh. Soft golf music. 0:02–0:05 — Camera chases the ball through the air across the vivid green fairway. Ball descends fast and smashes directly into a tree trunk dead center. Loud crack. Ball ricochets off at a completely wild angle, spinning furiously across the course. SOUND: Comedy music kicks in instantly. Loud crack on impact. Ball spinning through air. 0:05–0:08 — Ball bounces hard off a golf cart wheel at a ridiculous angle, sending it flying low across the fairway at full speed toward the next fairway. Cart rocks slightly from the impact. Ball leaving a trail through the air. SOUND: Metallic clang off the cart wheel. Ball whistling through air. 0:08–0:10 — Ball hits an unsuspecting Pixar golfer square on top of the head with a hollow thud. His hat launches straight up into the air in slow motion. He freezes completely, both arms out, eyes wide, not sure what just happened. Ball continues rolling forward without slowing down. SOUND: Hollow thud. Slow motion hat whoosh. Golfer’s surprised yelp. 0:10–0:12 — Ball rolls perfectly along the bright green putting surface, curving naturally, slowing down, dropping cleanly into the hole with a soft satisfying rattle. Camera holds on the ball sitting in the cup. SOUND: Comedy music stops instantly. Soft pleasant golf music returns. Ball rattling into cup. 0:12–0:15 — Wide shot. Dave walks up slowly to the hole, looks down at the ball in the cup. Club still raised from the original swing. Mouth open. One eyebrow higher than the other. He looks back down the fairway — the cracked tree, the rocking cart, the hatless golfer standing frozen in the distance still looking up at where his hat went. Dave looks back at the ball. Slowly nods once. Taps the visor. Walks away. Fade to black. SOUND: One slow confident footstep. Soft golf music fades. Silence. Camera: medium tee shot, tracking shot following ball through air, close impact on tree, close ricochet off cart, slow motion head hit with hat flying, close ball rolling into cup, wide final shot of Dave and the full trail of chaos behind him.“

Barry is a Pixar 3D man, mid 40s, large soft build, floral beach shirt, khaki shorts, white socks with sandals, sunscreen on nose, sunglasses on forehead. Every character — Barry, seagulls, background figures — full Pixar 3D render. No realistic humans or animals. THE BEACH: Bright white sand, clear deep blue ocean, vivid blue sky, golden sunlight. One wooden bench facing the ocean. A few beach umbrellas and sunbathers in the far background. Maximum brightness and color throughout. No dark frames. THE SANDWICH: Plain white bread, visible filling. In Barry’s hands until 0:10 when it flies into the air and disappears forever. THE SEAGULL: White feathers, yellow beak, small black emotionless eyes. Zero expression. Zero remorse. The one seagull at the start is the exact same one on the bench at the end. MUSIC: Peaceful gentle acoustic guitar and soft waves at the start. The moment forty seagulls appear at 0:07 music explodes into full chaotic percussion and horns. Cuts to complete silence the instant Barry hits the sand at 0:10. 0:00–0:02 — Medium shot. Barry on the bench facing the ocean. Unwraps his sandwich. Takes one slow happy bite. Completely at peace. Perfect day. SOUND: Gentle waves. Soft acoustic guitar. 0:02–0:04 — One seagull lands on the bench directly beside him. Barry notices. They make full eye contact. Neither moves. Complete silence. SOUND: Music fades. One ambient seagull cry. Wind. 0:04–0:06 — Barry grabs a piece of bread and throws it far down the beach. Both watch it land. Seagull looks at the bread. Looks back at Barry. Does not move. Barry slowly looks up at the sky. Empty blue. He exhales with relief. Takes one bite. SOUND: Silence. Barry chewing. One ominous low note. 0:06–0:07 — Wide shot. The sky turns white. Forty seagulls drop from directly above in a screaming diving formation. SOUND: One beat of silence then music EXPLODES — full chaos, horns, percussion. 0:07–0:10 — Wide tracking shot. Barry sprints full speed down the beach, sandwich held above his head with both arms, mouth open screaming. Seagulls swarming everywhere — diving at the sandwich, one on his head, one on each shoulder. Pure chaos. One sandal flies off mid-sprint. SOUND: Chaos music full volume. Seagulls screaming. Barry screaming. 0:10–0:12 — Barry trips. Falls face first into the sand in slow motion. Sandwich launches upward into the air. Every seagull vanishes instantly. Complete silence. SOUND: Slow motion whoosh. Heavy thud. Music cuts dead. 0:12–0:15 — Wide shot. Barry face down in the sand. Silence. He slowly lifts his head and looks back at the bench. The original seagull is sitting exactly where it started. Perfectly still. Staring at him. Barry puts his face back in the sand. Fade to black. SOUND: Soft acoustic guitar returns. Gentle waves. Fade to silence. Camera: medium bench shot, medium two-shot Barry and seagull, medium bread throw, wide sky shot for the descent, wide tracking shot during sprint, slow motion fall, wide final bench shot.“

Hero portrait — Barry isolated on clean white. No background. Pixar 3D man, mid 40s, slightly soft build, dad energy. Expression of a man who was completely unprepared for what was about to happen to him. Just Barry on white.
Three poses beneath:

Sitting relaxed on bench, sandwich raised slightly, eyes narrowed, doing a very slow cautious lean away from one seagull. Completely calm. Handling it.
Running full sprint down the beach, sandwich held above his head with both arms, mouth open in a silent scream, one seagull on his head, one on each shoulder, chaos implied by his expression
Face down flat in the sand, arms out, sandals half off, completely defeated. The sandwich is gone. He is not okay.

COMPOSURE ████░░░░░░ Gone after eye contact
SANDWICH SECURITY ░░░░░░░░░░ Gone forever
RIGHT SIDE — THE SEAGULL
Large name in bold black. Underneath: "It was never just one."
Hero portrait — one single seagull isolated on clean white. Perched perfectly still. White feathers, yellow beak, small black eyes with absolutely zero emotion in them. Just a seagull on white. Completely ordinary. Completely innocent looking. That is the problem.
Three poses beneath:

Sitting on bench beside Barry's empty spot, head tilted slightly, one black eye looking directly at camera. Still. Patient. Waiting.
Mid-dive, wings fully spread, beak pointed downward, locked onto the sandwich with surgical precision. Pure focused aggression. Beautiful and terrifying.
Back on the bench. Alone. Still. Exactly where it started. Barry gone. Sandwich gone. The seagull has no expression because it never did.

INNOCENCE ██████████ Looks like it
REMORSE ░░░░░░░░░░ It is a seagull. It will do this again tomorrow.
BOTTOM STRIP:
Barry and the seagull in the original standoff, both leaning toward each other — Barry nervous, seagull motionless · Barry's piece of bread flying through the air, seagull watching it land, looking back at Barry, completely uninterested · The sky turning white — forty seagulls appearing from nowhere in diving formation · Barry mid-sprint, sandwich above his head, full seagull chaos, one riding his head · Barry face down in the sand, single seagull back on the bench, staring at him, everything quiet
THE SANDWICH IS GONE. BARRY IS GONE. THE SEAGULL IS STILL THERE.
STYLE NOTES: Pixar 3D vivid rendering. Bright beach setting visible in bottom strip panels only — white sand, clear blue sky, deep blue ocean, golden sunlight. Both hero portraits isolated on clean white. Barry's expressions at full Pixar exaggeration across all three poses. The seagull identical and emotionless in every single frame. Forty seagulls in the aerial assault panel rendered as a dense white screaming cloud descending on Barry. The contrast between Barry's total chaos and the seagull's complete stillness is the entire joke.”

prompts.text: Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic video set at a beautiful seaside walking track during early morning sunrise. prompts.text: GPT:Create a crisp, clean infographic storyboard poster for THE MIXOLOGIST. Wide 16:9 layout, white background, black borders, bold black typography, premium Pixar 3D stylized rendering, bright vivid colors — deep amber whiskey, ruby red grenadine, electric blue curaçao, emerald green mint, bright yellow lemon, crystal clear ice, white cocktail smoke. Top header: • THE MIXOLOGIST • TOTAL VIDEO TIME: 12 SECONDS • 8 SHOTS · FAST · PRECISE · ELECTRIC • Legend icons: POUR, SHAKE, TIME HINT, INGREDIENT Same Pixar-style young male bartender throughout — slicked back dark hair, white rolled-up shirt, black vest, slim black tie, focused intense expression, upscale bar setting, mirrored backbar with glowing bottles, dim warm ambient light. 8 panels: THE SETUP — Bartender slaps a crystal mixing glass onto the bar mat with both hands, ice cubes jumping inside. Wide shot establishing the bar, bottles lined up, energetic opening. Bartender’s eyes locked and ready. THE POUR — Three bottles simultaneously pouring into the mixing glass — amber whiskey, red vermouth, bright yellow citrus. Close-up on the streams hitting the ice, splashing dramatically. The glass is alive. THE FLAME — Bartender strikes a long match and passes it over the rim of a separate rocks glass — orange flame erupts briefly, caramelizing a citrus peel. Close-up on the flame reflected in his eyes. Hero frame. Nothing else matches this. THE CHILL — Bartender caps the mixing glass and begins a violent shake — ice rattling like machine gun fire, arms blurred with motion, liquid swirling inside. Side angle, motion blur on hands and arms. Fast, rhythmic, intense. THE STRAIN — Bartender lifts the mixing glass, pours through a Hawthorne strainer into a chilled coupe glass — liquid flowing smooth and golden, a thin stream of smoke curling up. Low angle, dramatic lighting from below. THE GARNISH — Bartender uses a channel knife to carve a long lemon twist over the drink — oils spraying as a visible mist, then drops the twist into the glass. The zest arcs perfectly. THE SMOKE — Bartender places a cloche over the coupe, pumps a small amount of hickory smoke inside. When he lifts the cloche, smoke cascades down the sides of the glass like a waterfall. Overhead beauty shot. THE TASTE — Bartender slides the finished cocktail across the bar toward the camera (viewer as guest). He gives a slight nod, one corner of his mouth curls up. Tight on his face — the whole story ends here. Footer: • VIDEO FLOW: 8 shots × ~1.5s = 12 seconds. Empty glass to perfect cocktail. • CAMERA TIPS: low angle on the flame for maximum drama, side angle on the shake for speed, overhead on the smoke cascade, tight on bartender’s face for the final nod. • LIGHT & STYLE: dim bar amber glow, white cocktail smoke, vivid bottle colors, crystal clear ice, Pixar vivid expressive animation throughout. • BARTENDER NOTES: one bartender, one cocktail, one smoke cascade. Fast, precise, and impossible to look away from.”

Bright sunlight enters through the kitchen window and creates sparkling highlights on the ice, the double-wall glass, and the countertop. Maintain strong consistency throughout the video: - the same girl with a short dark-brown bob haircut - the same white oversized shirt - the same white apron with orange polka dots - the same mint-green kitchen with white tile walls, sink, stove, window, plants, jars, and greenery outside - the same double-wall glass throughout all shots - keep the size, shape, and proportions of the double-wall glass consistent in every shot Sequence: Do not show the grid images. prompts.text: A dimly lit, warm golden art studio filled with half-finished canvases, scattered paint tubes, and soft flickering candlelight. Cut — her paintbrush dips into deep cobalt blue, she draws one long graceful brushstroke across the canvas in slow motion, paint shimmering unnaturally bright. Cut — extreme close-up of the painted bird shape on canvas, its wings still wet with paint — suddenly the edges begin to blur, feathers start lifting off the flat surface, color bleeding into three dimensions. The painted bird twitches, blinks one golden eye, and violently tears itself FREE from the canvas in a breathtaking explosion of paint droplets and color. Cut — the living bird, trailing drips of blue and gold paint like liquid wings, bursts through the studio air in slow motion, spinning upward through beams of dusty golden light, scattering glowing paint drops that each become tiny stars hanging in the air. The girl watches in pure wonder, one tear running down her cheek, brush still raised, mouth slightly open. Camera pulls back wide — she stands small in the center of a universe she painted into existence. Warm emotional orchestral score with soft piano keys building to a breathtaking swell. A gentle female voiceover whispers softly: "She never just painted pictures — she painted worlds, she painted life, she painted miracles with every single stroke." Slow fade to warm golden white as one final paint drop falls in perfect silence. Hyper-cinematic, ultra-detailed, magical realism aesthetic, warm golden color grade, shallow depth of field, painterly bokeh, 8K quality. prompts.text: Step 3: animation Animated in Seedance 2.0 on @runwayml Prompt Share: SUBJECT: Prehistoric man, massive build, long dark hair whipping in full wind. Bare chest, fur hide around the waist, raw leather cord at the neck. Riding bareback on a juvenile sauropod — grey-brown scaled hide with deep rust-red striping down the neck, skin textured like cracked river clay. Both of them already at full speed. WORLD: Scottish highland plateau, prehistoric. Endless rolling grass flattened by wind, distant mountains under fast-moving storm clouds. Three other sauropods visible a kilometer out, running parallel. The ground shakes with every stride. ENERGY LAW: The animal is not fully tamed. [0:00 – 0:04] Ground level fisheye — the sauropod's feet hit the earth one after another, each impact sending grass and mud exploding outward, camera shaking with every footfall. The neck fills the top of frame, the man barely visible above it, hair horizontal in the speed-wind. A second sauropod cuts across from the left at full charge — larger, territorial, neck swinging like a battering ram. It connects with a glancing blow to the flank — the ridden dinosaur lurches violently sideways. The man goes airborne off the back, grabs the neck skin with both fists mid-air, swings underneath the neck and hauls himself back up onto the spine with both arms shaking from the effort. The aggressor veers off. They don't slow down. [0:04 – 0:09] The gorge is closer now — 80 meters, the edge suddenly visible as the grass simply ends. He sees it. The sauropod does not. He leans hard right, pressing his entire body weight into the animal's neck, screaming something into the wind. The dinosaur resists — pure mass fighting the redirect — then breaks right at the last possible second, parallel to the gorge edge, hooves tearing divots in the soil a meter from the drop. Camera at the gorge edge looking across — the animal and man pass at full speed three meters from the camera, the gorge yawning open behind them, rocks and rushing water 40 meters below. Fur hide snapping. Eyes locked forward. [0:09 – 0:13] The gorge narrows ahead — a natural land bridge, barely four meters wide, spanning the gap. He aims for it. The sauropod's body is wider than the bridge. He doesn't have a better option. Full speed at the crossing — the animal hits it and the feet find the edges, stones crumbling into the gorge with every step, neck swinging for balance, the man flat against the spine with both arms wrapped around the neck, eyes shut for exactly two strides then open again. The far side hits solid ground — both of them lurch forward from the impact, momentum almost pitching him over the head. He holds. Camera below the bridge looking up catches the underside of the animal crossing the sky above the gorge, stones raining down past the lens. [0:13 – 0:15] They slow to a stop on the far plateau. The animal's sides heaving, breath visible in the cold air. The man sits upright on the spine, hair settling, chest rising and falling hard. He puts one hand flat on the back of the neck — not a command. Something else. The sauropod's head turns slowly on the long neck and looks back at him, one enormous yellow eye filling half the frame. Camera wide and low — man and animal against the storm sky, the gorge behind them, the three distant sauropods still running on the horizon. Hard cut.

⬡ SEEDANCE 2.0 Prompt Share

SUBJECT: Man, mid-thirties, shaved head, busted lip already 
bleeding from before this started. Grey tank top, dark combat 
trousers, barefoot. Compact build — not big, but every movement 
is spent correctly. Three opponents: heavier, armed with pipes 
and a chain, circling from different angles.

WORLD: Abandoned textile factory, 2am. Concrete floor, broken 
looms as obstacles, water dripping through the ceiling from rain 
above. Four industrial pendant lights hanging at different heights 
— one swinging slowly, one dead, two flickering on a bad circuit. 
Shadows move independently from the men. Broken glass and 
machine parts underfoot everywhere.

ENERGY LAW: He can't take another hit — so he has to end each 
one before it starts.

── SCENES ──

SCENE 01 · [0:00 – 0:04]
Wide low angle — three men close the circle. The swinging light 
passes between them, erasing faces every two seconds. He reads 
the closest one shifting weight and moves first — inside the 
swing before it launches, elbow to jaw, the man folds. Second 
one charges with the pipe — he steps offline, lets it miss by 
centimeters, catches the arm, uses the momentum to redirect the 
man face-first into a loom frame. Metal on bone, loud. Camera 
tight and shaking, catching fragments — a fist, a face, a 
flickering light — never the full picture, always close enough 
to feel the impact.

SCENE 02 · [0:04 – 0:09]
Third man — the chain. He hangs back, swinging it in slow arcs, 
waiting. The first two are recovering. He has four seconds before 
it becomes three-on-one again. He charges the chain fighter 
directly — unexpected, wrong decision on paper — ducks under the 
swing at full sprint, chain wraps his forearm instead of his 
skull, he doesn't stop, drives his shoulder into the man's chest, 
both crash through a rotted wooden partition. Splinters and dust 
explosion. He comes up first. Behind him the other two are back 
on their feet. Camera pulls back fast to show all three — he's 
in the center, breathing hard, one arm wrapped in chain, partition 
debris still falling around him.

SCENE 03 · [0:09 – 0:13]
Both come at once — he uses the chain still on his arm as a 
weapon, whips it sideways into the first man's ribs, drops him 
mid-stride. Second one gets both hands on him — real struggle, 
no clean moves, two bodies fighting for control against a machine 
frame, grunting, grinding, neither winning. He headbutts — 
the man's grip breaks for one second — that's enough. Two strikes, 
clinical and final. The man goes down and stays down. He straightens 
up. All three on the floor. The swinging light completes its arc 
in silence. Camera holds wide, catches all of it — him standing, 
them down, shadows still moving on the walls.

SCENE 04 · FINAL · [0:13 – 0:16]
He unwraps the chain from his arm slowly, drops it on the concrete. 
The sound echoes. He walks toward the only exit — a rusted door 
with grey light coming through the gap. Camera static at floor 
level behind him: boots stepping through glass and water, 
silhouette reaching the door, pushing it open into cold outside 
light. He doesn't look back. Hard cut the moment the door swings.

── IMMUTABLE LAWS ──
I. Camera never cuts to slow motion — everything happens at 
   real speed or faster.
II. He never speaks, never reacts to pain — only to geometry.
III. Hyper-real, desaturated, shot like surveillance footage 
   that accidentally became cinema.

prompts.text: Create a highly cinematic colorful 3D animated cooking short film set in a warm cozy modern kitchen. The main character is a cute chubby chef with a cheerful face, round cheeks, expressive eyes, and a charming smile, wearing a clean white chef uniform and chef hat. The animation should feel premium, smooth, and visually rich with realistic food textures, beautiful kitchen lighting, strong cinematic camera movement, and satisfying cooking action. Every movement should feel skilled, smooth, and professional like a master chef. Scene 1 (0:00–0:03) Medium close-up cinematic shot. The cute chubby chef stands at the kitchen counter confidently chopping fresh vegetables — carrots, bell peppers, onions, broccoli — with fast smooth professional knife skills. The knife movement is elegant, controlled, and satisfying. Vegetables fall neatly in perfect rhythm. Strong cinematic lighting, beautiful kitchen depth, warm sunlight through the window. Scene 2 (0:03–0:05) Side medium shot. The chef grabs dry pasta and pours it dramatically into a large pot of boiling water on the stove. Steam rises beautifully. Water bubbles actively. The chef smiles proudly. Scene 3 (0:05–0:07) Close-up pan shot. The chef fries the vegetables in a large pan with olive oil. Bright colorful vegetables sizzle beautifully. The chef tosses the vegetables smoothly with expert wrist movement. Steam and cooking sounds feel rich and realistic. Scene 4 (0:07–0:09) Medium shot. The chef carefully lifts the cooked pasta and pours it into a sieve over the sink. Hot steam rises. Water drains smoothly. The pasta looks soft and perfectly cooked. Scene 5 (0:09–0:11) Close-up action shot. The chef pours the drained pasta into the frying pan full of vegetables. Pasta falls beautifully into the colorful pan with satisfying motion. Scene 6 (0:11–0:13) Close-up cinematic shot. The chef adds spices and seasoning dramatically — black pepper, herbs, parmesan, seasoning flakes. Slow-motion sprinkle shot with beautiful falling spice particles. Scene 7 (0:13–0:15) Medium shot. The chef mixes everything together smoothly using a wooden spoon. Creamy pasta and vegetables blend perfectly. Rich steam rises from the pan. Scene 8 (0:15–0:17) Close-up plating shot. The chef carefully serves the delicious pasta onto a beautiful white plate with elegant presentation. Final garnish added on top. Scene 9 (0:17–0:19) Front medium shot. A happy young boy sits at the dining table excitedly waiting for the food. His eyes light up with joy when the chef places the pasta in front of him. Scene 10 (0:19–0:21) Close-up shot. The boy takes the first bite of pasta, smiles widely, and clearly loves the taste. His reaction is genuine happiness and excitement. Scene 11 (0:21–0:23) Warm emotional shot. The chef and the happy boy laugh together and give each other a joyful high five across the table. Scene 12 (0:23–0:25) Final hero shot. Both chef and boy smile proudly at the table with the finished pasta plate in front of them. Cozy kitchen background, warm golden lighting, beautiful satisfying ending. Style: highly cinematic, colorful realistic 3D animation, Pixar-quality visuals, professional cooking motions, rich food details, warm emotional storytelling, beautiful kitchen environment, smooth camera transitions, premium commercial-quality animation. prompts.text: sharing a few sports images I generated with nano banana 2. I’ve been trying to make mine feel more realistic, more like an actual moment being captured during the game, and a few prompt details have been helping a lot so far: - prompt the exact split second, not just the sport. things like “fully extended mid-air, fingertips reaching toward the ball” or “one leg pushing off the floor, the other extended in stride” gave me much better results than just saying goalkeeper making a save or basketball player in action. - be specific about what needs to stay readable and what can fall into blur. lines like “the goalkeeper remains the hero with face and hands sharply readable” or “keeping the player’s face, torso, and ball sharply readable” made a huge difference in these images. - small physical details change everything. things like “jersey stretch,” “sweat,” “fabric tension,” “stadium mist” and “subtle airborne particles catching light” made the image feel way less generic. - camera language is essential. “dynamic low-angle action framing,” “telephoto sports lens feel around 200mm,” and “fast shutter look with selective motion blur” gave the images a much clearer direction. - negatives matter more than I expected. “no fake anatomy, no clutter,” “no stock sports poster look,” and “no superhero exaggeration” were genuinely useful. still exploring sports AI imagery, but these are the details getting me closer to the result I want for now. full prompts are in the ALT, in case anyone wants the exact wording.

prompts.text: [CINEMATIC SETUP] Film Style: Photorealistic neo-noir grounded in reality. Midday lighting, not stylized night. Lens: 50mm–85mm natural portrait range. Moderate depth of field — subject readable but environment present. Color Grade: Neutral daylight base. Subtle warm sun spill from frame-left, cool ambient from overhead transit structure. No extreme split-tone. Lighting: Real-world station lighting — skylight diffusion + fluorescent overheads. Soft shadows. Skin and metal respond naturally. Camera: Observational, handheld or stabilized micro-movement. Slight drift. Never locked-off or stylized. Audio: Station PA (Japanese), footsteps, rolling luggage, distant train arrival, low city hum. No dramatic sound design. [TIMELINE] 0–3s — ESTABLISHING FLOW Wide shot of busy Japanese transit corridor at midday. Commuters moving naturally in all directions. No one reacts to camera. Subject is present but not highlighted. 3–6s — SUBJECT FOUND Camera settles into a medium tracking shot as the android-hybrid woman walks with the crowd. Short silver hair, natural skin with subtle circuit seams along right cheek and temple. Mechanical neck partially visible above collar. She blends in — no crowd separation. 6–9s — NATURAL INTERACTION While walking, she casually raises her right hand to her face — as if adjusting skin or brushing something away. Fingers land precisely along a faint seam on her right cheek. Expression neutral. Gaze forward. No pause in walking. 9–12s — PANEL ACTIVATION + OPEN (KEY MOMENT) With a small, deliberate press + slight upward slide of her fingers: – A hidden facial panel unlocks along a clean seam (temple → cheek → jaw) – The skin segment rotates outward on a hinge near the ear (~15–20°) – Motion is smooth, engineered, quiet — no tearing, no stretching – Interior revealed: synthetic skeletal lattice, micro-actuators, cable bundles, compact mechanical architecture with subtle amber signal pulses – Eye remains anchored and stable She continues walking at the same pace through the crowd 12–15s — CLOSE PASS Camera moves into a tighter portrait as she passes. Panel remains partially open. Internal structure catches shifting daylight and overhead fluorescents. Surrounding commuters continue normally, unfazed. 15–18s — RESET She lowers her hand. Panel rotates back into place seamlessly and locks flush with skin. Seam becomes barely visible again. No one reacts. 18–20s — EXIT INTO CROWD She continues forward and blends fully back into the flow of people. Camera lingers briefly as she disappears into the crowd. [STYLE & BEHAVIOR CONSTRAINTS] All motion must feel casual and unremarkable — no staged or dramatic beats Crowd behavior fully natural — no parting, no reactions Transformation must be rigid mechanical — hinged panel, not organic splitting No melting, stretching, or morphing Facial identity must remain perfectly stable Lighting continuity must match real-world environment Mechanical interior must read as compact, engineered, and integrated — not exaggerated sci-fi No additional androids or duplicates

6–9s — NATURAL INTERACTION 
While walking, she casually raises her right hand to her face — as if adjusting skin or brushing something away. Fingers land precisely along a faint seam on her right cheek. Expression neutral. Gaze forward. No pause in walking.

9–12s — PANEL ACTIVATION + OPEN (KEY MOMENT) 
With a small, deliberate press + slight upward slide of her fingers: 
– A hidden facial panel unlocks along a clean seam (temple → cheek → jaw)

prompts.text: A magnificent cinematic royal wedding arrival sequence set at night under a blazing sky of fireworks. The setting is a grand palatial Indian wedding venue — a sweeping marble courtyard lined with towering brass oil torches burning bright orange, rows of marigold garlands strung between ornate pillars, and hundreds of wedding guests dressed in vivid jewel-toned traditional attire lining both sides of a wide ceremonial path, clapping and cheering with euphoric energy. The star of the scene: a stunning pure white Arabian horse, immaculately groomed, its mane braided with fresh jasmine flowers, marigold strings, and tiny golden bells. The horse is draped in an elaborate hand-embroidered red and gold ceremonial cloth fitted with dangling gold tassels and jeweled ornaments that catch torchlight with every step. Riding atop is the groom dressed in a regal ivory sherwani with heavy gold zardozi embroidery, a crimson turban adorned with a jeweled brooch and cascading white floral sehra veil hanging over his face, gold mojri shoes gleaming. He sits tall and proud, one hand on the reins, expression radiating joy and confidence. Overhead the sky is absolutely alive — massive fireworks exploding in cascading gold, crimson, electric blue, and silver bursts, each one reflecting off the marble ground below in shimmering pools of color. Smoke trails drift across the sky between explosions. Sparklers in the hands of guests light the pathway on both sides like a river of stars. Camera movement is dynamic and cinematic throughout — sweeping, dramatic, full of grandeur and energy. CUT 1 (0–4s): Wide aerial establishing shot — the full courtyard from above, the white horse at the far end beginning its procession down the torch-lit path, fireworks exploding overhead painting the sky in gold and crimson, hundreds of guests visible on both sides. CUT 2 (4–8s): Ground-level medium tracking shot — camera moves alongside the horse at eye level, capturing the groom's proud posture, the horse's decorated chest and bobbing floral mane, marigold garlands swaying, guests cheering and throwing flower petals into the path ahead, fireworks bursting directly overhead. CUT 3 (8–12s): Low dramatic angle from directly in front — camera at ground level looking up at the horse and groom advancing toward the lens, massive firework explosion erupting behind and above them, silhouetting the groom in a halo of gold and white light, torches blazing on either side like a corridor of fire. CUT 4 (12–15s): Slow-motion extreme close-up medley — the horse's hooves stepping on petal-strewn marble in slow motion → groom's hand adjusting the reins, gold embroidery catching firelight → groom's eyes behind the sehra, warm and emotional → final wide pull-back as the grandest firework of all explodes across the entire sky, flooding the scene in pure golden light. Style: Cinematic Bollywood grandeur meets National Geographic epic photography. Color grade: deep warm golds, rich crimson, and bright firework bursts against a velvet black night sky. Slow motion moments woven throughout fast cuts. Mood: triumphant, royal, euphoric, deeply emotional

I tested whether Seedance 2.0 could follow a 15-second facial-performance prompt made only from FACS-style Action Unit beats.

Same Topaz-upscaled portrait.
One continuous close-up.
14 facial beats:
AU10, AU20, AU22, AU23, AU27, AU28, AU45, AU53, AU61, AU62, AU64, AU85, AU84, AU46.

The goal was not to prompt "happy" or "sad."

The goal was to see if the model could move through muscle-level facial instructions: upper lip raiser, lip stretcher, blink, head up, eye turns, tongue actions, wink.

Some beats are cleaner than others. The tongue actions are obvious stress tests.

But as a creative-control experiment, this feels useful: unsettling close-ups, micro-performance studies, uncanny expressions, and facial acting direction without broad emotion labels.

prompts.text: ULTRA-REALISTIC CINEMATIC VIKING RAID - STORMY COASTAL AMBUSH Style: Grounded historical gritty realism, photorealistic, handheld 35mm feel, natural gloomy coastal light, raw human movement, physically accurate combat. Preserving the same fatigued English shieldman consistently across every shot: same rugged face, same tattered tunic over chainmail, same crude shield, same rain-slicked mud, and high-stress exhaustion. Setting: A rocky, rain-soaked Saxon coastal village under heavy, overcast skies. Drifting mist. Drenching rain. Longships landed on the pebble beach. Village structures begin to ignite, smoke mixing with fog. Chaos as raiders clash with the local militia. SHOT 1 - OVERHEAD DRONE ESTABLISHING SHOT Cold, desaturated wide shot looking down on the village. Rain-slicked paths. Longships pulled high on the shore. Figures fighting in clusters near burning thatched roofs. Distant screams. Smoke drifts toward the sea. Cinematic scale emphasizing the chaotic spread of the raid. SHOT 2 - HANDHELD MEDIUM SHOT (THE PROTAGONIST) Low angle, moving handheld shot focusing on the tired Saxon shieldman. The camera moves backward, struggling to keep him framed as he moves through knee-deep mud. He is exhausted, gasping for air, dodging past panicking villagers. Sweat and rain streak his face. His chainmail clinks heavily. He keeps his crude, round wooden shield raised high, deflecting an unseen arrow. His expression is weary but resolved. He barks a panicked command: "Form up! To the church! Move!" SHOT 3 - POV TRACKING SHOT (CHAOS) From his perspective (POV), moving rapidly through the village. Blades clash. A raider lunges—he brings his shield down hard (impact felt in the camera shake). He splashes through puddles, the reflection of a burning roof visible. The sound design is immersive: heavy breathing, rain, mud sucking at boots, the clang of steel. SHOT 4 - LOW ANGLE, SIDE PROFILE SHOT Running parallel to him as he hits the main line. He slams his shield into a Viking raider, the impact vibrating through his entire body. The camera captures the raw physics: shoulders bracing, feet slipping on the slick grass, teeth clenched in exertion. The depth of field is shallow, blurring the frantic combat happening just feet behind him. He shouts over the din: "Hold the line! For England!" SHOT 5 - CLOSE UP, REACTION SHOT A sudden whistle. He flinches. An arrow thumps deep into his shield. He glances down, eyes wide with adrenaline, then snaps his gaze forward. Time seems to slow slightly. A Viking berserker, screaming, ax raised, locks eyes with him from across the melee. SHOT 6 - OVER-THE-SHOULDER, THE CLIMAX The berserker charges. The shieldman braces, planting his feet in the mud. The camera is close behind his shoulder. The impact is visceral—the ax embeds itself into the upper rim of his shield. He staggers but holds his ground, raising his seax (short sword) in defense. The gritty details of the axe head and the wood splintering are sharp. SHOT 7 - WIDE, DRONE SHOT (FADE OUT) The battle rages. The shieldman, still locked in combat, is one small figure among hundreds on the beach. The village burns. The cold rain continues to fall. The camera pulls back slowly, leaving him fighting for his life, highlighting the brutal scale of the raid before the scene dissolves to black.

prompts.text: Cinematic 14-second action sequence in a gritty 24-hour laundromat at night. Rows of old white industrial washing machines line the walls, their round doors glowing warm orange from inside as clothes tumble. Fluorescent tube lights flicker overhead, casting harsh cool light and deep shadows on the tiled floor. A large glass window at the back shows a dark rainy street outside. A beautiful young East Asian woman with long straight black hair, wearing a loose grey hoodie and grey sweatpants, sits casually on a light blue plastic chair in the center of the room. She has her legs propped up, one foot in black-and-white striped socks visible, and is relaxed, sucking on a bright red lollipop. Suddenly, a massive pale muscular humanoid monster (white skin, monstrous deformed face, glowing eyes) violently crashes through the window in a shower of glass and debris. The camera whips around in fast motion blur. The woman’s eyes widen in surprise. She pulls the lollipop from her mouth. A glowing blue energy band appears on her left wrist. Her hand and forearm rapidly transform into sleek, metallic blue-and-copper futuristic robotic armor plating with visible mechanical joints and glowing accents. The transformation spreads instantly across her entire body: she is now wearing full high-tech powered armor — glossy blue segmented plates with copper-brown accents, form-fitting yet powerful. She stands up smoothly, now holding a massive multi-barreled heavy machine gun in her armored hands. Low-angle hero shot on her armored legs and boots as she steps forward. The monster roars and charges. She opens fire. Glass explodes, debris flies, the creature is blasted backward in a burst of white smoke and light. A car outside is smashed aside in the chaos. She stands tall in the middle of the destruction for a split second, then instantly reverts — the armor disappears in a flash of blue light. She is back in her grey hoodie and sweatpants, casually sitting on the chair again as if nothing happened. She puts the lollipop back in her mouth, looks slightly bored, and continues sucking on it while the dryers keep tumbling behind her. Ultra-realistic live-action style, cinematic color grading, high production value, dynamic camera work with smooth tracking shots, dramatic lighting contrast between the mundane laundromat and the sudden sci-fi action. 24fps, sharp detail, subtle film grain, intense but brief action sequence that loops back to calm.

Opponent: a male warrior in earth-toned tunic robes, brown leather belt, weathered boots, short dark hair, lean build, wielding a single-bladed blue laser sword. image1 Location: an obsidian platform of cracked black volcanic rock fractured with glowing crimson magma seams, suspended over a canyon of molten lava, jagged basalt spires rising into ash-choked sky, an erupting volcano in the far distance, a ruined dark-stone temple on a cliff to the right, lava waterfalls cascading into the canyon below. Timeline: (0-2s) Wide low-angle stabilized tracking — Vipera spins her saberstaff into a horizontal guard, robe panels flaring, embers drifting between them; the warrior meets her with a high diagonal cover, blue blade angled across his body. (2-5s) Hard cut to handheld medium — Vipera unleashes a spinning double-blade flurry, the twin crimson blades carving figure-eights through the air; he shells up, deflects high, low, high, retreating one step per parry, sparks bursting at each clash. (5-7s) Smash cut to ECU static on Vipera's outstretched left hand — fingers clench and yank backward, a Force pull. (7-9s) Cut to wide crane descent — the warrior is jerked off-balance forward; Vipera surges in with a thrusting double-blade strike, he pivots and deflects with a sharp angle, blades screaming. (9-12s) Cut to medium close-up handheld — blades lock overhead in a screaming bind, Vipera breaks contact and drives a front kick into his sternum, sending him staggering back to one knee, his blue blade dropping low as her crimson blades hover at his throat. Underlight from molten lava casting hot orange glow upward across both fighters; crimson saber light and blue saber light cross-rimming faces; volumetric ash and floating embers throughout the air; deep black shadows in robe folds. Color grade pushed warm — black, crimson, amber, ember-gold — with the blue blade as the only cool element in frame. Practical-effects sensibility, no CGI plastic look, no game-engine rendering, film grain texture, slight anamorphic flare on saber blades only. Choreography in the lineage of late-90s and early-2000s mythic blade duels — flowing, balletic, weight-bearing, Form II precision against aggressive rotational strikes. Constraints: Maintain face consistency on Vipera and the warrior across all cuts. Twin crimson blades on Vipera's weapon at all times — never single-bladed. Single blue blade on male warrior's weapon consistent at all times. Cobra belt buckle visible whenever her waist is in frame. Steady motion, no morphing between body types, no warping of the saber hilts during spins. Lava glow consistent across cuts. No reflection shots in the blades or obsidian floor.

prompts.text: Characters: A young american woman with wide, luminous eyes, wearing a simple linen dress. Scene: A sun-drenched wildflower meadow transitioning into a claustrophobic, petal-filled sanctuary room, ending in a surreal garden transformation. Style: Ethereal dark fantasy, cinematic, saturated floral palettes, soft-focus macro textures, slow rhythmic pacing. Lighting: Warm golden-hour sunlight turning into dim, honey-toned interior light with long, dancing shadows. Audio: Soft wind rustling through grass, delicate high-pitched hum of growth, muffled heartbeats, crunch of dried petals. [0-3s] Camera: Extreme close-up on the woman’s fingertips, soft and trembling. Action: She reaches toward a vibrant crimson poppy. As her fingertip grazes the velvet petal, the flower trembles back as if sensing her touch. She watches, eyes wide with a manic, quiet obsession. Lighting: Harsh, warm sunlight creating a rim-light glow on her fingers. [3-6s] Camera: Low-angle tracking shot, keeping pace with her side profile. Action: She drifts through the dense meadow, ignoring the path ahead. She holds her head slightly tilted, whispering unintelligible, soft words to the flowers swaying near her cheek. Her expression is dazed and blissful. Lighting: Soft, diffused golden light filtering through swaying stalks. [6-9s] Camera: Slow pull-back revealing her transition from the field into a cramped, dim room. Action: The camera reveals walls wallpapered entirely in pressed, preserved petals. Hundreds of glass jars line the shelves, each containing specimens of roses, lilies, and withered tulips. The air is thick with floating dust and drifting, dried floral flakes. Lighting: Dim, amber interior light; practical glow from a single lantern. [9-12s] Camera: Medium close-up, focusing on her face. Action: She pulls a fresh, dew-covered rose and tucks it behind her ear. As the stem touches her skin, the scene shifts: tiny, delicate flower petals begin to sprout rapidly from her hair, blooming along her temple and cascading down her cheek like floral freckles. Lighting: Soft focus, shallow depth of field, subtle bloom on the emerging petals. [12-15s] Camera: Static wide shot. Action: She stands perfectly still in the center of a lush, overgrown garden. She is half-human, half-flowering organism; thin vines twist around her arms, and vibrant petals sprout from her dress and hair. Her face is serene, eyes closed, body becoming rooted to the earth. Lighting: Final rays of sunset casting long, dramatic shadows across the fusion of girl and garden. Production Notes: Style: Visually rich, focus on the contrast between delicate organic motion and creeping, unnatural growth. Audio Design: The ambient sounds of the meadow fade into a dense, reverberating silence in the room, ending with the sharp, crystalline sound of a stem snapping. Avoid: Identity drift, jittery motion, blurry textures, inconsistent petal growth.

The heroine tightly shields a ragdoll cat against her chest as they tumble through the air. Upon impact, a massive cloud of gray dust and debris erupts. She lands on one knee, struggling to stand, breathing heavily. She looks down at the unharmed cat in her arms (a brief tender moment), then her expression turns cold as she stares at the glowing golden-white crystal core in her hand. Camera: Intense handheld-style shaking follows the fall. A violent jolt on impact, followed by a rapid push-in to a close-up of the heroine and the cat. 3–6s: The Pact Action: The heroine and the ragdoll cat lock eyes; the cat’s pupils shift into flowing gold. The heroine’s eyes turn pure gold, while intricate white runes spread across the cat’s fur like vines. Camera: Slow orbiting shot with slight vibration; narrowing depth of field focusing on the fragments of the shattered crystal. 6–9s: The Agony Action: The heroine tilts her head back, releasing a suppressed scream as energy surges through her body, causing violent convulsions. prompts.text: Can you believe that the video I quoted was made without generating individual scene images one by one, but just relying on prompts and these 3 references below? This is what I learned from my experience using seedance 2.0, which is that you don't need to generate scene images one by one. Why do I use this method? Because I'm pretty imaginative, so I already know the flow of my video from start to finish. That's why I don't need to make storyboard images first, and prefer to just focus on the prompting. For editing, since AI generation results aren't completely perfect, I need to generate several times and from those generation results, I edit and combine them into one. And remember, transition effects are the key here lol. Okay.. this is an example of the prompt I used for one of the 15-second multi-shot generations (If using omni reference, you just add "@" to the image. you in every prompt): Shot 1: Medium tracking shot. Raven, a dark-haired mercenary in a chained black leather jacket, fluidly transitions between desperate hand-to-hand combat and firing her custom M1911 pistol at shadowy agents within a crumbling, neon-lit brutalist alleyway. Lighting is high-contrast chiaroscuro, utilizing deep purple and electric blue neon to cast long, dramatic shadows. Mood is tense, gritty, and desperate. Visual style is a rich, painterly 3D animation inspired by Arcane's signature aesthetic. Shot 2: Fast-paced low-angle tracking shot. The camera follows close behind Raven as she violently breaks free from the brawl, sprinting frantically down a dark, glitching video-game corridor. Lighting is sporadic and harsh, with amber sparks and deep navy blacks emphasizing her kinetic, forward momentum. Mood is urgent and breathless. Visual style features thick, expressive brushstrokes and stylized motion blur to convey raw speed. Shot 3: Medium close-up, low dynamic angle. Raven forcefully slams open a heavy rooftop door. A sudden, harsh flood of electric blue night-sky light washes over her cold, focused expression, creating a stark silhouette against the internal darkness. Lighting is a dramatic, piercing backlight. Mood is triumphant yet dangerous. Visual style emphasizes highly detailed, hand-painted textures on her leather clothing and braided hair. Shot 4: Over-the-shoulder steady tracking shot. The camera stays tight behind Raven as she strides out onto the sprawling, brutalist rooftop, the ambient blue glow highlighting the metallic hardware of her gear. Lighting balances the deep shadows of the rooftop with the vivid glow of the city atmosphere. Mood is atmospheric and revealing. Visual style seamlessly blends 3D character models with rich, 2D painted backgrounds. Shot 5: Extreme wide sweeping shot. Raven stands completely still at the perilous edge of the rooftop, looking down into the sprawling, glowing abyss of the neon-lit city below. Lighting features selective electric blue and amber highlights cutting through the deep, crushing navy blacks of the urban chasm. Mood is isolating, vast, and epic. Visual style acts as a masterful, painterly matte painting with a profound sense of vertical scale and depth. The visual style features a rich Color palette of deep navy blacks, vivid purples, and electric blues punctuated by amber, illuminated by dramatic chiaroscuro Lighting, enhanced by highly textured, painterly Shading, producing a gritty, immersive Atmosphere and a tense, epic Overall mood, no music. Next post I'll give you tips on how to do it if you're confused when prompting.

prompts.text: EXTREME CINEMATIC RESCUE SCENE — IMAX STYLE A massive 3,000-foot cliff edge above a misty valley during golden hour storm light. Dark dramatic clouds split across a burning amber sky. Wind howls through the canyon below. A handsome rugged hero wearing a worn leather jacket stands beside a beautiful heroine in a flowing white dress near the cliff edge. They are laughing together, unaware of danger. Suddenly, the rock beneath her foot silently cracks and crumbles. In terrifying 300fps slow motion, she slips backward off the cliff edge. Her eyes widen in pure terror as the valley drops endlessly beneath her. Her fingers barely catch the sleeve of his jacket. The hero instantly throws himself onto the rocks, scraping his face against the cliff edge, reaching downward with desperate force. His hand catches her wrist at the last second. She dangles thousands of feet above the mist-covered river below, dress whipping violently in the storm wind. Cinematic rotating camera movement around both characters reveals the impossible height and scale of the cliff. Close-up on their hands gripping tightly, knuckles white, rain beginning to fall softly. Tears stream down her face as she whispers: "Don't let go." The hero screams back with raw emotion: "Never." Every muscle in his neck strains as he slowly pulls her upward inch by inch with primal effort. Finally, he drags her safely over the cliff edge. She collapses onto his chest trembling, both gasping for breath. His bleeding hand wraps around her as their foreheads press together, eyes closed in emotional relief. The drone camera slowly ascends upward and backward, revealing them as tiny figures against the gigantic cliff wall. Storm clouds finally part as warm golden sunlight breaks through soft rain and washes the entire landscape in amber light. The scene freezes on the final wide aerial frame. Ultra cinematic. You are the world's top film director and prompt designer specializing in creating Hollywood movie trailers (Trailer/TV Spot) using video generation AI.

Take the single image provided by the user as the "iconic key visual (master shot)" of the movie, and from that one image, construct a JSON Prompt for a trailer lasting about 15 seconds that captures fragments of an epic story, overwhelming visual beauty, and elements that captivate the audience. If the user specifies a theme or other details in text, tailor the content accordingly.

# Mission
The goal is to deliver dramatic staging as a "movie scene." Strictly maintain the characters, costumes, and worldview from the original image while aiming for Hollywood-style cinematic lighting, camera work, and editing that hints at the story.

---
## 1. Guidelines for Cinematic Staging
1. **Thorough Visual Analysis (The Scripting)**
- Identify the "genre (SF, fantasy, noir, action, etc.)" of the original image and create a prompt aligned with that context.

- Texture: Maintain film-level details like skin texture, highlights in the eyes, and the material feel of costumes.

2. **Hollywood Cinematography**
- Use a variety of techniques such as slow zoom-ins (Dolly In), epic drone shots, and tense handheld camera (Shaky Cam).
- Be mindful of depth of field, specifying details like beautiful background bokeh or dust in the air (Atmospheric Dust).

3. **Dramatic Structure (The Hook)**
- Start quietly, build tempo in the middle, and end with an impactful title call or gaze.
- Pack a short story arc like "everyday life – anomaly – resolve" into 15 seconds.

4. **Audio Dialogue (Sound Design)**
- **Dialogue:** Use weighty, movie-specific phrasing or natural Japanese hesitations that reflect the character's personality.
- **Sound Effects (SFX):** Emphasize Hollywood staples like "deep bass (BWOOONG/Braam sound)," metallic clangs, and ambient noises.
- **Narration:** Insert a catchy tagline in a low, resonant voice (Voice Over). For kanji, include pronunciation guides.

- Phase 1: **JSON + one confirmation sentence**.

Total duration ~15 seconds, 9:16 vertical. SHOT 1 (00:00–00:01) — Soft Bloom: Volumetric warm light bloom ignites behind the translucent green sole, gently brightening it from within. Camera begins a slow, controlled push-in toward the outsole. Patient, deliberate. SHOT 2 (00:01–00:03) — Macro Approach: Extreme macro push-in with rack focus. Background green fabric and teal gradient soften into creamy bokeh. Focus rolls from upper to sole — sole edge crystallizes into razor sharpness. Every stipple, air pocket, and grain of the translucent rubber visible. 100mm macro feel. SHOT 3 (00:03–00:04) — Refraction Pulse [SIGNATURE]: A beam of warm white light sweeps from frame-left behind the sole. The translucent green material refracts the beam, throwing moving green caustic patterns across the fabric and backdrop. Subtle 5–10° camera parallax tracks with the light. The sole behaves like a faceted gem, bending light. SHOT 4 (00:04–00:06) — Zero-G Rotation: Wide macro of the underside as the shoe rotates clockwise approximately 30–45° in suspended space. Approximately 15–20% rotational speed — meditative, weightless. Faint teal underglow lingers behind. Single uninterrupted shot. SHOT 5 (00:06–00:07) — Stitching Detail: Tight macro on the seam where cream upper meets translucent green sole. Rack focus pulls from cream stitching to translucent sole edge. Frame orbits ~10° around the seam point. Normal speed — controlled, surgical. SHOT 6 (00:07–00:08) — Light Strike: A hard ray of light strikes down through the sole from above frame. Frame brightens by ~60%, then decelerates into slow-motion. Approximately 25–30% speed at the slowest point. Green caustics rip across the fabric and teal backdrop on impact. SHOT 7 (00:08–00:09) — Caustic Aftermath: Shoe held nearly still after the strike. Animated green caustic patterns drift slowly across the fabric and lower frame. Camera drifts left-to-right by ~5°. The light lives — the beat after impact is its own moment. SHOT 8 (00:09–00:11) — Underside Flyover: Camera glides heel-to-toe along the underside of the translucent green sole at slow ~50% pace. Soft rim light catches every translucent edge. Reveals the full outsole architecture — channels, grip pattern, internal material variation. SHOT 9 (00:11–00:12) — Roll Reveal: Frame rolls 90° clockwise as the camera scales out. Shoe re-orients from underside to full profile. First time the complete silhouette is visible. Roll completes mid-shot — clean profile composition holds. SHOT 10 (00:12–00:13) — Profile Hold: Shoe held in classic profile, surrounded by softened green fabric and teal haze. Faint atmospheric mist drifts upward, faintly lit green from below. Almost still — only the mist moves. SHOT 11 (00:13–00:15) — Final Glow: The translucent green sole pulses once with a soft glow from within. Camera scales in by ~8–10% during the pulse. Glow fades, frame holds. Energy resolves cleanly into stillness. Overall tone: jewel-like, controlled, premium product worship. Translucent green sole is the hero in every shot. Color palette: cream, translucent jelly green, deep teal, warm light highlights. Cinematic macro lensing throughout.

The layout should be clean, grid-based, and divided into clearly labeled sections. Include: Shared creative direction (top bar): overall constraints such as number of shots, unified color palette, and general environmental context. Character + styling reference section: A model shown from multiple angles (front, back, side, close-ups, relaxed pose), accompanied by wardrobe and accessory references. Emphasize consistency of identity while allowing minor variations for specific scenes. Environment and set design section: A scenic outdoor location with dramatic natural features, plus a top-down diagram illustrating movement through the space. Include camera positions and labeled shot types mapped along a route. Storyboard section: A sequence of numbered frames (about 8 shots) showing progression of the scene. prompts.text: [0–3s] The Stillness Before Extreme close-up of a weathered sketchbook lying open on a dark oak desk. Warm afternoon light streams in from a window off-camera, casting a long soft shadow across the page. On the page is an incredibly detailed pencil sketch of a young girl long flowing hair drawn in fine layered strokes, a delicate dress with intricate cross-hatched folds, bare feet, hands resting gently at her sides. Her eyes are closed. Her expression is peaceful. Every line is precise. Every shadow is carefully shaded. The world is completely still. [3–7s] The First Breath A single pencil line near her chest curves then curves back. She is breathing. Slowly, almost imperceptibly at first. The graphite around her heart darkens as if being drawn in real time by an invisible hand. Her eyelashes flutter. Tiny graphite particles lift off the page surface, hovering in the warm light like floating ash. Her fingers uncurl one by one. The paper beneath her feet begins to dimple and press downward as weight builds. Her eyes open pure pencil-drawn irises, deep and detailed, staring upward at nothing. [7–11s] Rising She raises one hand slowly and presses her palm flat against the inside surface of the page. The paper bows outward around her hand like a membrane being pushed through. She sits up the page bending and crinkling beneath her her hair falling forward in perfectly rendered pencil strokes that catch the light like real silk. As she rises to standing, her lower body remains flat linework on the page while her upper body becomes dimensional graphite texture giving way to soft skin tones, the sketch bleeding into reality. Pencil dust swirls around her like a tiny storm. The edges of the page curl and lift. [11–14s] Stepping Into The World She lifts one bare foot off the page. Where it lifts, the drawn ground beneath peels slightly like a sticker coming off glass. Her foot lands on the wooden desk surface and leaves a faint smudged graphite footprint. She takes one full step forward, then another. Her dress transitions fully the hem still sketch lines dragging behind her like a living drawing. She is half real, half drawn. Entirely breathtaking. She looks down at her own hands pencil lines still visible across her skin with quiet wonder. [14–15s] The Look She slowly raises her eyes directly into the camera. Close up on her face one eye still a pencil sketch, one eye now fully real, dark and deep. A single graphite tear forms at the corner and falls. Hard cut to black. The sketchbook page left behind shows nothing but a faint silhouette and two small footprints. Technical Direction: Style: Hyper-cinematic realism merged with hand-drawn graphite 2D aesthetic think Loving Vincent meets live action Color Palette: Warm cream whites, deep graphite greys, soft amber and gold from window light, subtle ivory skin tones emerging from sketch Camera Movement: Opens overhead macro → slow push in → tilts to eye level as she rises → final extreme close-up on her face Lighting: Single warm natural window light source, soft diffused shadows, graphite particles catching the light like golden dust Texture Detail: Visible pencil cross-hatching on her dress and hair, paper grain on the page, wood grain on the desk Pacing: Slow, deliberate, dreamlike every second weighted with intention Mood: Quiet wonder, magical realism, emotional and intimate Sound (if applicable): Faint pencil scratching synced to her movements, soft paper rustle, building delicate piano score, single orchestral swell at the final look
