prompts.text: Seedance prompt Use @Image1 as the character reference, @Image2 as the gully cricket court reference, and @Image3 as the choreography reference. Create a 10-second cinematic realistic cricket batting video with 16 counts, following the 16 shots from @Image3 in order. Character: young Indian teenage male, slim athletic build, tan brown skin, short curly hair, wearing the RCB jersey (bold red, black panels, gold trim), black cricket trousers, white batting pads, white batting gloves, and black cricket spikes from @Image1. Keep his identity, outfit, and proportions consistent throughout. Ball: a standard red cricket ball with white seam stitching. Location: use the same Indian gully cricket environment from @Image2: narrow concrete alley, chalk crease markings, painted stumps on a wall, chawl buildings, overhead wires, warm afternoon daylight. Important — cricket is NOT fluid like football freestyle. Each shot is a distinct, explosive movement: the ball arrives from off-screen (as if bowled), the batter reads it, sets his feet, and plays the shot with full bat swing, then briefly resets into batting stance before the next delivery. Cuts between shots should feel like quick-fire consecutive deliveries in a nets session or street cricket game — fast but purposeful, not continuous flow. The batter must remain fully visible in full body at all times, from head to toe, with no cropped framing. Keep him centered in frame, facing mostly toward the camera or at a slight angle, staying near the crease. The camera should track him smoothly while always keeping his entire body and the bat swing arc visible. Timeline / 16 counts / 10s 0.0–1.2s 1 Cover Drive — front foot stride, full bat swing down the ground 2 Straight Drive — head over the ball, straight bat, drives back past the bowler 1.2–2.4s 3 Pull Shot — back foot pivot, horizontal bat, plays the short ball to square leg 4 Cut Shot — back foot, bat comes down across the line, cuts to point 2.4–3.6s 5 Hook Shot — swivels, bat loops around the head, hooks over square leg 6 Sweep Shot — drops to one knee, horizontal bat sweeps to fine leg 3.6–4.8s 7 Leg Glance — wrist flick, deflects the ball to fine leg 8 Forward Defence — big front stride, dead bat blocks the delivery 4.8–6.0s 9 Reverse Sweep — kneels, reversed grip, sweeps to off side 10 Scoop Shot — crouches low, scoops the ball up and over the keeper 6.0–7.2s 11 Lofted Drive — high follow-through, drives the ball over the infield 12 Switch Hit — flips grip mid-delivery, plays unconventional shot to off side 7.2–8.4s 13 Upper Cut — rises on back foot, cuts steeply rising ball over the slips 14 Flick Shot — wrist-dominant, flicks through mid-wicket off the hips 8.4–10.0s 15 Helicopter Shot — full rotation of the bat after contact, ball dispatched over mid-wicket 16 Style Finish — bat raised high, triumphant pose, looking into camera The sequence should feel like a rapid-fire batting showcase — explosive, confident, and street-authentic. Use cinematic realism, natural ball physics, realistic bat-swing mechanics, and sharp cuts between deliveries. Camera: mostly wide or medium-wide full-body framing, gentle handheld tracking, minimal reframing, no close-ups that crop the body, no extreme angles. Always keep the full batter and bat swing visible. Occasional slow-motion on the most dramatic shots (helicopter, lofted drive). Sound: sharp crack of bat on ball for each shot, crowd murmur building with each hit, street atmosphere — distant traffic, kids cheering, ending with a cheer on the Style Finish.

A metal chair gets kicked aside, sliding across the floor. 5–8s — ENVIRONMENT USE Second agent grabs a tablet device, swings it — impact hits shoulder. Body hits the ground hard — strong but grounded impact. Breathing heavy, immediate recovery — no pause. 13–15s — FINAL STANDOFF Both agents quickly rise, circling slightly. Red emergency lights pulse across their faces. Camera slowly stabilizes, holding tension as they prepare to strike again. Cut ends mid-motion for intensity.

prompts.text: Anamorphic 2.39:1, ARRI Alexa 65 look. Lesnie/Wagner visual language — desaturated steel-blue palette, volumetric moonlight, atmospheric haze, painterly chiaroscuro. Camera: Single continuous FPV drone shot, no cuts. Smooth, deliberate cinematic glide. Beat 1 — Approach (0–5s): Aerial drone descends through storm clouds toward a battle-scarred ancient citadel at night. Colossal wooden Trojan Horse looms in silhouette against a bruised, cloud-torn sky — eighty feet of blackened oak bound in oxidized bronze, rain-slick and steaming. Cold silver moonlight shafts. Drone glides past sleeping Trojan sentries on the battlements, embers from a dying victory pyre drifting across frame. Distant thunder. Beat 2 — Ascent (5–9s): Camera spirals upward along the horse's massive neck, passing carved war-runes and Athena's sigil branded into timber. Rain beads roll down the grain. Drone reaches the carved head and pivots to face the wooden jaw, cracked slightly ajar. A single shaft of moonlight cuts across the opening. Wind moans low through hollow timber. Beat 3 — Threshold (9–11s): Drone glides through the horse's open mouth. Total darkness swallows the lens for one held heartbeat. Faint sounds bleed through: creak of leather, whetstone on bronze, muttered prayer in ancient Greek. Beat 4 — Interior Reveal (11–15s): Camera emerges into the cavernous belly, lit only by a single shielded oil lamp swaying from a beam. Twenty Achaean warriors crouch along the timber ribs — Odysseus at center, finger pressed to his lips. Bronze hoplite helms with horsehair crests. Lambda-emblazoned shields. Iron xiphos blades drawn across knees. Faces streaked with soot, eyes glinting with cold resolve. One warrior kisses an amulet of Ares. Lamp flickers across faces — Caravaggio chiaroscuro. Final frame holds on Odysseus's eyes, hard and unreadable. Lighting: Cold moonlight exterior, warm flickering oil-lamp interior. High contrast. Volumetric god-rays through cloud breaks and timber gaps. Color: Desaturated cyan-blue shadows, crushed blacks, amber firelight highlights. Teal-and-bronze palette. Sound: Low sub-bass drone, distant thunder, wind through wood, rope creak, single distant horn note, held breath, leather and metal whispers. Mood: Ominous, sacred — the silence before annihilation. The calm of men who know they will not see another sunrise the same way. Negative: No modern elements, no CGI sheen, no cartoonish proportions, no daylight, no cuts, no shaky cam, no artificial lens flares.

prompts.text: Shot 1 (00:00–00:02) – WS, Rainy Night, Forward Tracking A narrow, ancient village alley drenched in relentless rain. Water streams down slanted rooftops and floods uneven stone pathways, reflecting flickering lantern light. A young girl runs barefoot through the المياه, her soaked dress clinging to her as she struggles to keep balance. Behind her, shadowy figures move unnaturally—distorted, stretching and glitching with each lightning flash as they close in. VFX: Heavy rain simulation, reflective wet surfaces, lightning illuminating distorted shadows. SFX: Thunder cracks, rapid splashing footsteps, howling wind. Shot 2 (00:02–00:04) – CU, Panic Fall, Slight Handheld Shake She suddenly slips and crashes onto the wet stone. Water splashes outward. Close on her face—rain mixes with tears, her breath sharp and uneven. Her trembling hands push against the ground as she tries to move back, eyes locked on the approaching darkness. VFX: Detailed splash simulation, motion blur, lens water droplets. SFX: Intensifying heartbeat, heavy breathing, rain striking surfaces. Shot 3 (00:04–00:06) – LS, Violent Ground Eruption The ground beneath the shadows fractures violently. Stone explodes upward in a powerful shockwave, sending debris and المياه into the air. A massive dragon bursts from below—its body dark and armored, faint glowing veins pulsing beneath its scales. It rises between the girl and the shadows, instantly scattering them into fragments of darkness. VFX: Ground destruction, flying debris, glowing cracks, volumetric dust. SFX: Deep impact boom, layered dragon roar with sub-bass rumble. Shot 4 (00:06–00:08) – CU, Emotional Realization, Slow Push-In The girl freezes, looking up. Her fear begins to fade. Lightning briefly illuminates the dragon’s face—its glowing eye calm, focused. The reflection of that eye fills hers. The rain appears to slow slightly in this moment. VFX: Eye reflection detail, subtle slow-motion rain, soft glow from dragon’s eye. SFX: Thunder fades into low ambient tone, rain softens. Shot 5 (00:08–00:11) – MS, Gentle Interaction, Static Frame The dragon slowly lowers its massive head toward her, movements controlled and careful. It gently nudges her shoulder. Water droplets slide across its scales, glowing faintly as they fall. She hesitates, then slowly lifts her hand toward it, tension leaving her body. VFX: Subtle bioluminescent pulses under scales, detailed water interaction. SFX: Deep calm breathing, soft ambient hum. Shot 6 (00:11–00:13) – LS, Protective Wing Expansion The dragon spreads its विशाल wings wide, forming a protective barrier around her. Rain violently hits the outer surface of the wings, but inside the space becomes still—dry, warm, and silent. The contrast between chaos outside and calm inside is immediate and striking. VFX: Rain deflection on wings, cold blue tones outside vs warm glow inside. SFX: Wind muffled, rain hitting wing surface, low protective resonance. Shot 7 (00:13–00:15) – CU, Emotional Close, Soft Fade She places her hand gently against the dragon’s face. At the moment of contact, a warm golden light spreads outward, gradually replacing the cold storm tones. The rain visually and audibly fades. Her expression softens completely—fear replaced by trust. The dragon slowly closes its eye. The scene fades into darkness with a lingering glow between them. VFX: Warm light bloom, gradual rain fade-out, soft vignette fade. SFX: Ambient tone dissolving into silence, final soft breath.

INK INDUSTRIES : GAME TRAILER CHARACTERYoung athletic male, dark curly hair, shirtless, full chest and back tattoos, gold hoop earring, cigarette in mouth, black cybernetic prosthetic arms with cyan LED nodes at joints. Black shorts with white stripe, white socks, beige chunky sneakers. Seated cross-legged on white void floor. CINEMATIC SETUPOpens on clean white void environment with minimal game UI. Camera high angle looking down at character. Hyper-realistic CGI rendering, clean white background transitioning to dense cyberpunk favela environment. SEQUENCE [0s–15s] [0s–2s] High angle shot looking down. Character seated on white floor, looking up at camera with cigarette smoke rising. Game menu UI on left: START NEW GAME, CONTINUE highlighted, SETTINGS, EXIT GAME. Player profile top right showing INK_NOMAD LVL 23. A cursor clicks CONTINUE. The button pulses. Subtle bass hit. [2s–4s] Smooth zoom-in toward his left arm. UI panels slide in from left LEFT ARM EQUIPMENT panel appears. Selection highlights PHANTOM GRIP, then slides to CHRONOS CLAW. His left hand mechanically reconfigures fingers split apart, new claw-like digits lock into place, cyan LEDs pulse brighter. Stats bars animate on right panel. Servo click sounds. [4s–7s] Camera orbits smoothly around to his right side. New UI slides in ARMAMENT CUSTOMIZATION grid showing HAND, FOREARM, ELBOW, UPPER ARM components. Selection cycles through parts rapidly. His right arm disassembles section by section forearm plates detach, new plating slides on, elbow joint swaps, hand reconfigures with exposed wiring and pistons visible mid-swap. Each component locks with a mechanical snap. Tech Points counter ticks up. [7s–8.5s] Camera pulls back to medium shot. CONFIRM CONFIG button pulses. Click. All UI panels collapse inward. Character uncrosses legs, shifts position, now sitting relaxed, one knee up, cybernetic hand bringing cigarette to mouth. Smoke curls. [8.5s–10s] LOADING bar appears at bottom. Fills rapidly 0 to 100%. White environment begins darkening shadows creep in from edges, warm golden light bleeds through. The white void dissolves like fog burning off. Character starts standing up in one fluid motion. [10s–15s] Full environment loads around him as he rises to his feet. Dense cyberpunk favela materializes, neon signs flickering on, wet streets reflecting light, crowds populating, motorcycles, tangled power lines, stacked buildings climbing toward futuristic skyscrapers in the distance. Camera settles into third-person view behind him, showing his full tattooed back. HUD elements fade in, minimap top left, health bar, ammo counter bottom right. Quest marker appears. He takes a step forward into the street, puddle splashing under his shoe. Golden hour light cuts through the alley. Ambient city noise floods in, chatter, distant music, neon buzz. STYLEHyper-realistic CGI. White void sections: clean, minimal, studio-lit. Gameplay section: dense Cyberpunk 2077 / Assassin's Creed open-world density, golden hour lighting, wet reflections, volumetric haze. Seamless transition from sterile UI to living world. No cuts, one continuous camera move. SOUNDUI sections: clean digital clicks, mechanical servo sounds, subtle electronic hum. Loading transition: rising bass drone. Gameplay reveal: full ambient soundscape floods in city noise, distant bass music, footstep splashes. 后期:用 DaVinci Resolve 剪辑 + Topaz 提升画质和帧率

prompts.text: Scene 1 Action: A scavenger in scuffed, utilitarian EVA gear pushes through a jagged bulkhead into the silent, debris-choked hold. Camera: Handheld kinetic style, tight on the scavenger’s shoulder to capture the claustrophobic scale of the ruins. Lighting: Cool, desaturated ambient light, starkly broken by the erratic, flickering beam of a shoulder-mounted LED. Sound: Muffled mechanical breathing through a respirator, dry crunch of calcified debris under heavy, magnetized boots. Dialogue: 'Signal is peaking. Whatever's in here... it’s still active.' Scene 2 Action: The air pressure shifts violently, sucking loose ash upward into a localized, swirling vortex in the center of space. Camera: Wide shot, steady tracking, emphasizing the vast emptiness of the ruined station against the small scavenger. Lighting: Dramatic backlighting from the swirling ash, casting long, distorted shadows that dance across the rusted bulkheads. Sound: Deep, resonant low-end hum that causes the camera to shake, layering in the sound of metal groaning under pressure. Scene 3 Action: Vharuun descends from the rafters, his robes trailing mist as he drifts perfectly still on the floating monolith. Camera: Rack focus from the scavenger’s shocked expression to the steady, calm gaze of Vharuun hovering in the gloom. Lighting: Soft, eerie bioluminescence emanating from the censer orb, bathing Vharuun in a ghostly, monochromatic pallor. Sound: Distant, fading echoes of a thousand voices whispering in unison, overlaid with the chime of metal on stone. Dialogue: 'I am the final witness to your collapse.' Scene 4 Action: Vharuun lifts the censer orb, and the scavenger instinctively retreats, weapon held at a trembling low-ready stance. Camera: Shallow depth of field, profile shot capturing the tension between the futuristic gear and ancient necromancy. Lighting: Sharp, high-contrast lighting highlighting the texture of the scavenger’s suit versus the smooth, matte void. Sound: Sharp, electrical crackle of energy discharging from the monolith, followed by an abrupt, absolute silence.

He steps in, briefly studies the moment, removes the cup from her hand, takes a síp, then carefully places it back exactly as it was. He then turns his attention to the camera, raises his hand again, and snaps his fingers, releasing a more powerful shockwave that rapidly spreads outward, reversing the effect as motion instantly resumés - pedestrians continue walking, pigeons scatter into flight, the woman carries on unaware still holding her coffee, and debris drops naturally to the ground as full city sound returns. He pauses for a brief moment, then continues walking forward, gradually blending into the crowd while the camera keeps tracking backward, maintaining distance as he disappears into the flow, ending in a smooth fade out. prompts.text: Hyper-realistic cinematic shot of a crowded train station during heavy rainfall at night. Water pours from the station roof in continuous streams, splashing onto wet reflective tiles that mirror flickering station lights. Commuters move in blurred motion with umbrellas and soaked clothing, creating a dense, emotional atmosphere of rush and noise. In the foreground, a young man stands still, holding a train ticket in his hand, his posture tense and uncertain. Across the platform, a young woman stands under dim yellow station lighting, completely still, staring at him in silence. Their eye contact holds without words, separated by train tracks filled with rushing water and reflections. The camera slowly pushes in toward both of them, isolating their connection despite the crowd. A train approaches, its headlights growing brighter, wind and sound intensifying. As it arrives, it passes directly between them, fully blocking their view with motion blur, metal, and light streaks. For a few seconds, everything disappears behind the moving train. When it clears, the platform feels subtly changed. Only one of them remains visible on the opposite side. The other is gone. The crowd continues as normal, but the emotional weight of emptiness lingers. Cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic rain physics, reflective surfaces, slow dramatic camera movement, 8K realism, no text, no logos, no subtitles.

prompts.text: Seedance 2.0 Prompt Share: Blockbuster 3D game cinematic NHL playoff opener. A colossal armored French-Canadian knight titan battles a Lightning Storm God titan inside a frozen hockey arena. [0:00-0:03] Camera rises from beneath the ice surface, pushing up through cracking frozen glass into the arena. Blizzard swirls. The Montreal Voyageur Knight titan stands at center ice — crimson and blue armor gleaming, fur cape whipping in arctic wind, enchanted ice hockey stick gripped in both hands. Camera orbits its massive frame as frost breath pours from the visor. The CH logo on its chest pulses with blue light. It slams the stick on the ice — a shockwave cracks the entire rink surface in a radial pattern. The crowd roars. [0:03-0:06] A massive lightning bolt strikes the opposite end of the rink. Camera whip-pans to reveal the Tampa Lightning Storm God materializing from pure electricity — its body barely contained plasma, crackling white-blue arcs jumping between its limbs. It raises its lightning staff and fires a concentrated beam across the ice. Camera tracks the beam at ice-level as it scorches a molten trail across the frozen surface. The knight raises its shield — the beam deflects upward, shattering the arena scoreboard in a shower of sparks and glass. [0:06-0:09] The knight charges across the cracked ice — camera at low angle, lateral tracking, ice chips spraying from every heavy footstep. The Storm God teleports in a flash of lightning to meet it. They clash — enchanted stick vs lightning staff — the collision creates an electromagnetic pulse that blows out every arena light. Camera captures the moment in strobe-lit darkness, each flash freezing a frame of combat. Sparks and ice crystals fill the air. The knight spins and delivers a devastating cross-check — the Storm God fractures into a thousand lightning bolts that scatter across the arena walls. [0:09-0:12] The scattered lightning bolts reassemble behind the knight. Camera follows from above in a crane shot as the Storm God reforms — bigger, angrier, pure electrical fury. It grabs the knight and launches both upward through the arena roof into the stormy sky. Camera follows the vertical ascent — arena shrinking below, clouds swirling around them. They trade blows mid-air above the city skyline, each impact creating thunder that echoes across the frozen landscape. [0:12-0:15] Both titans plummet back down through the shattered arena roof, crashing onto center ice in a cataclysmic impact. Camera captures the landing from ice-level — shockwave radiating outward, boards splintering, glass shattering. Slow-motion pull back through settling ice dust and electrical discharge. "MONTREAL VS TAMPA" typography materializes from ice crystals and lightning arcs. NHL chrome shield logo slams into frame. Stanley Cup Playoffs. Arena lights flicker back on revealing both titans standing, ready for more. Unreal Engine 5 meets Mortal Kombat arena cinematography. Icy blue-white atmosphere with crimson red and electric blue as only saturated elements. Heavy camera shake on every impact, speed ramping, anamorphic flares reflecting off ice. Avoid static camera, avoid weightless movement. Sound: ice cracking, heavy metallic footsteps on ice, lightning crackling and thunder, crowd roaring, glass shattering, massive bass impacts, arena horn blaring, epic orchestral score with war drums building to brass crescendo. No dialogue.

prompts.text: 01 - Disaster film realism, one-take. The camera begins above a coastal container port in a night typhoon, gantry cranes swaying over black water, then dives toward a dock worker running across stacked cargo lanes under screaming wind. The camera follows inches behind as he weaves between sliding containers, ducks beneath a swinging crane cable, climbs a rain-slick stair tower, and crosses a narrow maintenance bridge high above the floodwater. A ship breaks loose from its moorings below, smashing into the dock and sending a shockwave through the structure. He jumps to a control platform just as a collapsing crane crashes into the stacks behind him. Sodium lights, rain sheets, spray bursts, steel impacts, one continuous shot, no cuts. 02- Disaster film realism, one-take. The camera begins above a rain-lashed steel railway bridge spanning a swollen canyon river, then dives toward a maintenance worker running along the roof of a stalled passenger train. The camera follows him as he sprints over slippery carriages, leaps a widening gap between cars, grabs an emergency ladder, and drops into a shattered service gangway inside the train. Water punches through broken windows as the bridge begins to twist. He climbs back out onto the front engine platform and jumps to the stone embankment just as the rear section of the bridge collapses, dragging half the train into the torrent below. Grey rain, steel flex, river spray, violent thunder, one continuous shot, no cuts. 03- Disaster film realism, one-take. The camera starts above a mountain town at dusk as a wildfire front races over the ridgeline, then plunges toward a firefighter running through a narrow hillside street choked with burning embers. The camera tracks close behind as he kicks open a gate, vaults over a fallen power line, pulls a child’s bicycle from his path, and squeezes through an alley while flames curl over rooftops on both sides. He bursts into a terraced backyard as a propane tank erupts behind him, then slides down a dusty slope toward an evacuation bus just as the firestorm consumes the street he came from. Orange-black smoke, ash storm, heat shimmer, ember trails, one continuous shot, no cuts. 04-Disaster film realism, one-take. The camera begins high above a frozen research station on a cracking ice shelf under whiteout blizzard conditions, then dives toward a lone engineer sprinting between radar towers as the ice splits open beneath him. The camera follows tightly behind as he jumps over widening fissures, ducks under whipping cables, slides across an ice-glazed catwalk, and dives through a half-closing bulkhead door. Behind him, an entire laboratory module shears away and drops into black freezing water. He emerges onto the outer deck just as a wall of ice collapses and the station begins to tilt toward the sea. Blue-white storm light, spindrift, hard wind, heavy structural groans, one continuous shot, no cuts.

Shot 05 (0:09–0:12) Sudden side-impact shot, the creature bursts out of the fog and slams into the hunter from frame left, mud and wet leaves exploding upward, the weapon spinning away. Shot 06 (0:12–0:15) Wide chaotic pullback through the fog as the hunter is dragged across the ravine floor while the giant furry beast disappears back into the mist, leaving only thrashing branches and muffled growls.

prompts.text: Seedance 2.0 prompt share: Blockbuster 3D game cinematic. A colossal cannon golem titan battles a dark magpie knight titan in and around a massive football stadium at night during a thunderstorm. [0:00-0:03] Establishing aerial drone shot of the stadium in a lightning storm. Camera pushes down through the clouds toward the pitch. A massive bronze cannon golem stands on the left side of the field — ancient bronze armor steaming in the rain, its cannon arm glowing white-hot, charging. Emirates Stadium architecture visible behind it. Camera orbits slowly around the golem as bronze gears turn and steam vents hiss. It aims its cannon arm upward and fires a massive artillery shell into the sky — the muzzle flash illuminates the entire stadium for a split second. [0:03-0:06] The shell explodes mid-air — and from the explosion the Magpie Dark Knight descends, black and white steel armor gleaming with rain, massive dark feathered wings spread wide. It grips a crackling lightning sword. Camera tracks its descent in a dramatic slow-motion follow shot. It lands on the opposite side of the pitch with earth-shattering force — the ground craters, turf explodes outward, sprinkler pipes burst. Lightning strikes behind it as it rises to full height. [0:06-0:09] Both titans charge at each other across the pitch. Camera at ground level, lateral tracking shot between them as they converge. The golem fires rapid cannon blasts — each one tearing up the field. The knight deflects with its sword, each deflection creating a lightning shockwave. They meet at the center circle — the cannon arm clashes against the lightning sword in a devastating lock. Camera spirals upward around the impact point as energy radiates outward. [0:09-0:12] Close-up combat sequence with dynamic camera. The knight slashes — the golem blocks with its bronze shield arm, sparks flying. The golem retaliates with a point-blank cannon blast to the knight's chest — the knight slides backward 50 meters, digging trenches in the pitch. Camera follows in a crash-zoom. The knight spreads its dark wings and launches forward at impossible speed — sword-first through the smoke. [0:12-0:15] Both titans lock weapons overhead in a final clash — camera captures the moment from below in an epic low-angle shot. The combined energy creates a vertical beam of bronze fire and white lightning that pierces the storm clouds. Camera pulls back to a majestic wide shot — the stadium framing both titans, the energy beam splitting the sky. "ARSENAL VS NEWCASTLE" forges itself in molten bronze and crackling lightning. Premier League golden shield materializes. Thunder rolls. Dark Souls meets Elden Ring boss cinematography. Rain-soaked battlefield, dramatic lightning illumination, heavy motion blur on fast strikes, speed ramping from slow-mo to real-time on impacts. Bronze warm tones vs cold steel monochrome. Avoid static camera, avoid clean movements — every shot has weight, grit, and physical consequence. Sound: cannon fire booming, lightning sword crackling, metallic clashing, rain hammering, thunder rolling, ground breaking, crowd roaring distantly, epic war drums building to full orchestral crescendo with brass fanfare on the final reveal.

prompts.text: Seedance 2.0 Prompt share: Blockbuster 3D game cinematic. A colossal werewolf beast titan battles a cockerel knight titan in and around a massive football stadium during a stormy golden-hour eclipse. [0:00-0:03] Camera starts tight on golden wolf eyes in pure darkness. They ignite. Camera rapidly pulls back to reveal the massive Wolf Beast titan — dark fur bristling, gold armor pulsing with energy, fangs bared. It stands in the center of the stadium, hunched forward in a primal attack stance. It throws its head back and howls — the sound echoes across the arena, shattering glass in the press boxes. Golden energy shockwave radiates from the howl. Molineux stadium structure visible behind. Camera shakes from the sonic force. [0:03-0:06] Camera whip-pans 180 degrees to the Cockerel Knight striding through the stadium entrance gate — navy armor gleaming with blue lightning, silver crest magnificent, lance crackling with energy, shield raised. Camera tracks alongside as it walks with regal, measured power. It plants its lance into the ground — a wave of blue energy ripples across the pitch toward the wolf. Camera follows the energy wave at ground level until it hits the wolf's feet. [0:06-0:09] The Wolf Beast charges on all fours — camera at wolf-eye level, FPV chase shot, ground tearing beneath massive claws. The knight braces and launches forward with its lance. They collide — the wolf catches the lance in its jaws, the knight drives forward. Camera orbits rapidly around the grapple. The wolf snaps the lance, claws slash across the knight's shield sending it flying. The knight counters with a lightning-charged gauntlet uppercut. Camera captures the impact in slow motion — shockwave distorting rain droplets. [0:09-0:12] Aerial combat shot — the wolf leaps impossibly high, gold axe raised overhead. Camera follows from below in a dramatic upward crane. The knight spreads its wings and meets it mid-air. They trade three devastating blows mid-flight — each one creating a shockwave visible from the stadium below. Camera cuts between close-up impact shots and wide stadium shots showing the scale. On the third blow, both are blasted apart. [0:12-0:15] Both titans land on opposite sides of the pitch, crouching, breathing heavily, staring each other down. Camera executes a slow dramatic push-in between them — both filling the frame edges. Steam rises from the destroyed pitch. Rain falls. Then both roar simultaneously — the combined sound creates a golden and blue energy sphere at center field that expands into the "WOLVES VS SPURS" typography. Premier League golden shield materializes. Final epic wide shot — both titans silhouetted against a stormy sky split between gold and navy blue. Monster Hunter meets Shadow of the Colossus cinematography. Primal savage energy vs disciplined knightly precision. Golden warm tones vs cold navy steel blue. Speed ramping on every major impact, handheld shake during combat, smooth crane shots for establishing scale. Every movement has bestial weight and medieval consequence. Sound: primal wolf howl, metallic lance impacts, claws scraping armor, thunder rumbling, rain hammering, crowd chanting like a war choir, deep taiko drums accelerating through combat, massive orchestral brass and choir crescendo on final reveal.

Lighting: Blazing Brazilian beach afternoon, harsh equatorial sun overhead, deep blue Atlantic ocean behind, white sand reflecting light upward, golden rim light on skin, natural lens flare, shallow DOF. The air shimmers with heat. [0:00–0:03] A packed Brazilian beach at peak afternoon. People laughing, beach vendors shouting, children running, a volleyball game mid-play in the background. Waves crashing rhythmically. Steadicam frontal medium shot tracking a strikingly beautiful Brazilian beach attendant — sun-kissed skin, dark wavy hair loose in the sea breeze, wearing a vibrant bikini, a small tray balanced perfectly on one hand loaded with tropical drinks, coconuts and fried snacks. She weaves through beach chairs with total effortless grace. A man sits in a low beach chair directly ahead of her, gazing at the ocean, completely unaware, holding an almost-finished caipirinha with no garnish — a detail she notices immediately. She raises her free hand slowly and snaps her fingers. [0:03–0:06] The snap triggers a spherical shockwave of light refraction that expands outward from her hand at the speed of sound. The entire beach freezes in a single instant. A wave is suspended mid-crash, every droplet hanging in place, the white foam caught in an arc like sculpted glass. A child frozen mid-leap above the sand, feet off the ground. A beach ball is suspended mid-flight, perfectly still against the deep blue sky. Grains of sand thrown up by the volleyball game hang at every height like tiny planets. Absolute silence. Only the heat shimmer still moves above the white sand. [0:06–0:09] Only she moves. Her bare feet pressing softly into the sand with each step, leaving perfect prints. The camera retreats slowly as she weaves through the frozen tableau. She passes frozen vendors mid-shout, mouths open, hands raised. She ducks under the suspended wave droplets — each one a perfect sphere refracting the sunlight into tiny rainbows. She reaches into her tray and picks up a single wedge of fresh orange, examining it against the frozen blue sky, light passing through it like stained glass. [0:09–0:12] She stops beside the man in the beach chair — face frozen mid-gaze at the ocean, completely at peace, caipirinha glass tilted slightly in his relaxed hand. She studies the glass. With complete calm she takes the orange wedge and slides it perfectly onto the rim of his glass. She tilts the glass ever so slightly upright in his frozen hand so it sits perfectly level. She steps back, tilts her head, satisfied. She smirks — slow, private, unbothered. [0:12–0:15] She snaps again. The shockwave reverses — identical light refraction contracting back toward her hand, played perfectly backwards. The wave crashes with full thundering sound. The child lands in the sand laughing. The beach ball smacks into a hand. The vendors resume shouting. The full noise and heat of the beach floods back in one single roaring instant. The man lifts his caipirinha to his lips and notices the orange wedge — he looks around confused, smiling. She is already gone, weaving back through the crowd, tray still perfectly balanced, sea breeze lifting her hair.

prompts.text: 0:00 - 0:03 Begin with an extreme low-angle shot skimming above the swamp water, racing through reeds toward the gigantic ant. The camera whip-tilts up his towering legs to reveal his massive face in the fog. He drops into the first bar, mandibles moving rhythmically, antennae snapping to the beat. He stomps a leg into the water, sending a huge splash into camera. Transition through the splash. 0:03 - 0:06 Cut into a dramatic orbiting medium-wide shot circling the ant as he raps to camera. He dances with wild insect swagger, crossing and punching outward with his front legs while his whole body bounces to the rhythm. The human figure below looks tiny by comparison. The camera swings around his head, then pushes between his moving legs for a surreal parallax effect. 0:06 - 0:09 Smash cut to a top-down shot above the swamp. The ant dances in a huge circular pattern, splashing water outward while the camera spirals downward. As he keeps rapping, the spiral accelerates and becomes a Dutch-angle close-up of his face, one giant eye reflecting the swamp. His antennae flick in sync with the flow. 0:09 - 0:12 The camera rushes past his face into a side-tracking shot as the ant struts sideways through the swamp like a giant rap icon on a runway. Each step lands on the beat, sending ripples and mud bursts across the water. He hits a wild dance break, folding and unfolding his legs in intricate patterns, body dipping low then rising high. Use speed ramps and brief freeze-frame accents on his best poses. 0:12 - 0:15 For the climax, the camera cranes rapidly from the tiny human observer up to an enormous frontal hero shot of the ant centered in frame, fog swirling behind him like stage smoke. He delivers the final lines directly to camera while dancing full force, front legs pumping and torso swaying with superstar confidence. The swamp reflects his silhouette. Then the camera rockets into one giant black eye, which becomes a tunnel of blue light and fog

35mm Kodak 5247, anamorphic, dense film grain, hot pink and teal key light, wet Miami streets at 2am, chrome flares, black sky, oceanfront haze, glossy reflections everywhere.
00:00–00:02 · THE V12
Open on the Countach V12 at macro scale. Intake runners, cam covers, belts, and mechanical details assemble from darkness. Camera glides through the engine bay as everything locks into place.
00:02–00:04.5 · THE WEDGE
The body forms in sequence: razor nose, dramatic windshield rake, side intakes, louvers, and wide rear stance. Scissor doors rise slowly. Camera skims low across the angular surfaces and impossible geometry.
00:04.5–00:07 · THE INTERIOR
Cream leather interior builds itself. Analog gauges illuminate softly. The metal gated shifter rises from the center console. Camera lingers on polished switches, stitching, and chrome details.
00:07–00:10 · MIAMI WATERFRONT
The finished white Countach settles onto rain-slick Miami pavement beside a neon waterfront at 2am. Pink and teal signs streak across the bodywork. Palm shadows and mist drift through frame.
00:10–00:13 · NIGHT ORBIT
Slow orbit around the wedge profile, rear louvers, phone-dial wheels, and open scissor door silhouette. The city lights bleed into the wet ground and bay behind it.
00:13–00:15 · END CARD
Hard cut to black. One flash of neon. The Countach nose emerges from darkness for a final beat. Grain, heat, reflection. Hold.

Color grade: Deep ocean blue, harsh midday sun glare, dramatic regatta aesthetic with "LIVE SPORTS" UI overlay. Audio: Immersive spatial sound — wind filling sails, hull cutting through water, waves, dramatic sports commentary — suddenly interrupted by a deep prehistoric oceanic rumble rising from below. [SKIPPER DESCRIPTION — ANATOMY CRITICAL] The skipper is a bald man with a grey beard, athletic build. Civilian sailing attire only: light canvas trousers, polo shirt. No helmet, no racing suit, no gloves. This description is fixed and must not change across all shots. [GLOBAL ANATOMY RULE] A sailing yacht moves by wind power only. No engines. Realistic sail physics and hull hydrodynamics in all shots. [TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND] 0–2s: [Wide tracking shot] Open ocean regatta already underway. A fleet of racing yachts cuts through deep blue water under full sail — white canvas taut against the wind, hulls heeled, spray flying from bows. TV broadcast framing with "LIVE SPORTS" UI overlay. 2–5s: [Aerial drone, high angle] The lead yacht approaches a race marker buoy and executes an extreme tacking maneuver. The vessel heels to nearly 90 degrees — the mainsail lays almost flat against the ocean surface, mast nearly horizontal, hull edge cutting through the water. The yacht holds this impossible angle rounding the buoy. 5–10s: [Close-up tracking shot] The water beside the lead yacht darkens and churns. A colossal prehistoric sea creature erupts from below — ancient, barnacled, enormous — and clamps its jaws directly around the hull, lifting the entire vessel out of the water. The yacht rises into the air, mast swinging skyward, sails still full of wind. 10–15s: [Wide shot — final frame] The bald, grey-bearded skipper — light trousers, polo shirt — pushes off hard with both legs from the stern where he was seated at the helm and launches himself outward and downward. Camera follows his body in freefall — rapid descent toward the ocean surface. Final frame: the moment of water entry — a sharp white explosion of splash. Hard cut to black.

prompts.text: FORMAT: 15s / 140 BPM / 9 SHOTS / beat-synced cinematic trailer from the 3x3 storyboard grid STYLE: IMAX live action, dark amber palette, practical firelight and gold luminescence, photorealistic 8K. MOOD: Epic ancient combat, visceral tension, triumphant finale. MUSIC: Deep war drums, metallic percussion, rising orchestral brass. SHOT 1 (0:00-0:02): Wide establishing shot. Massive ancient colosseum at dusk, marble columns with gold circuit veins, torchlight flickering across the tiers, storm clouds above. Slow aerial push-in. SHOT 2 (0:02-0:03): Interior wide. Arena floor from the stands, thousands of spectators in torchlit shadow, amber firelight on wet marble. Camera glides forward. SHOT 3 (0:03-0:05): Close-up iron gate. Rusted ancient bars. Two glowing amber eyes emerge from darkness. Smoke curls through gaps. Camera pushes in slow. SHOT 4 (0:05-0:07): Medium shot. Gladiator in weathered bronze armor with gold circuit patterns enters the arena, marble shield raised, short sword drawn. Camera tracks alongside. SHOT 5 (0:07-0:09): Wide action. Massive mechanical lion with obsidian plating charges across the arena, fire erupting from its jaws, dust and sparks trailing. Camera sweeps low. SHOT 6 (0:09-0:10): Dynamic close-up. Shield blocks the lion attack, sparks explode where metal meets stone, gold circuits on armor flare bright. Camera shakes with impact. SHOT 7 (0:10-0:11): Low angle. Gladiator on one knee, battered, shield cracked, mechanical lion circling in dust and firelight behind him. Camera holds steady. SHOT 8 (0:11-0:13): The kill. Gladiator drives his sword upward through the lion jaw, blade glowing gold, mechanical parts shattering outward in slow motion. Camera tracks the upward thrust. SHOT 9 (0:13-0:15): Victory. Gladiator stands alone center arena, arm raised, gold circuit patterns pulse across the marble floor radiating outward. Camera pulls back wide.

Step 2: Feed the grid to Seedance 2.0 I2V as the start frame.

Use the grid image as your start frame and describe each shot's motion, camera, and audio in your prompt. Seedance reads the grid, animates each panel in sequence, and generates a native soundtrack.

Prompt we used:

"FORMAT: 15s / 140 BPM / 9 SHOTS / beat-synced cinematic trailer from the 3x3 storyboard grid

STYLE: IMAX live action, dark amber palette, practical firelight and gold luminescence, photorealistic 8K.
MOOD: Epic ancient combat, visceral tension, triumphant finale.
MUSIC: Deep war drums, metallic percussion, rising orchestral brass.

SHOT 1 (0:00-0:02): Wide establishing shot. Massive ancient colosseum at dusk, marble columns with gold circuit veins, torchlight flickering across the tiers, storm clouds above. Slow aerial push-in.

SHOT 2 (0:02-0:03): Interior wide. Arena floor from the stands, thousands of spectators in torchlit shadow, amber firelight on wet marble. Camera glides forward.

SHOT 3 (0:03-0:05): Close-up iron gate. Rusted ancient bars. Two glowing amber eyes emerge from darkness. Smoke curls through gaps. Camera pushes in slow.

SHOT 4 (0:05-0:07): Medium shot. Gladiator in weathered bronze armor with gold circuit patterns enters the arena, marble shield raised, short sword drawn. Camera tracks alongside.

SHOT 5 (0:07-0:09): Wide action. Massive mechanical lion with obsidian plating charges across the arena, fire erupting from its jaws, dust and sparks trailing. Camera sweeps low.

SHOT 6 (0:09-0:10): Dynamic close-up. Shield blocks the lion attack, sparks explode where metal meets stone, gold circuits on armor flare bright. Camera shakes with impact.

SHOT 7 (0:10-0:11): Low angle. Gladiator on one knee, battered, shield cracked, mechanical lion circling in dust and firelight behind him. Camera holds steady.

SHOT 8 (0:11-0:13): The kill. Gladiator drives his sword upward through the lion jaw, blade glowing gold, mechanical parts shattering outward in slow motion. Camera tracks the upward thrust.

SHOT 9 (0:13-0:15): Victory. Gladiator stands alone center arena, arm raised, gold circuit patterns pulse across the marble floor radiating outward. Camera pulls back wide."

Note: Seedance 2.0 I2V sometimes generates the grid itself as the opening scene. If that happens, trim it with the Movie Editor in Venice Studio — or make the first two panels in your grid the same image if you need that shot as your opening frame.

prompts.text: Use @ Reference Image as the main character, keeping facial features, turban, and body proportions consistent throughout. He is a 25-year-old Punjabi Sikh man Cinematic time-freeze short film, 15 seconds, ultra-realistic, shot on Arri Alexa Mini, 35mm lens, Anamorphic flare, moody stadium interior lighting with floodlight beams cutting through, Kolkata Eden Gardens at night, volumetric haze from firecrackers and dust, dynamic hard shadows, shallow depth of field, teal and orange cinematic color grading. [0:00–0:03] A packed Eden Gardens stadium, time flowing normally. Steadicam frontal medium shot tracking him walking confidently through absolute chaos. On the giant blurred LED screens in the background, India has just hit the winning boundary — the World Cup is ours. 80,000 people are erupting in pure euphoria, tricolor flags waving, firecrackers bursting, confetti cannons firing. The crowd is jumping, hugging, screaming "India! India!" As he walks through the VIP aisle between the roaring stands, he raises his right hand and snaps his fingers. [0:03–0:06] At the snap, a subtle spherical shockwave bursts from his fingertips with visible air distortion and light refraction, expanding outward in slow motion. Everything freezes mid-explosion. Thick arcs of golden chai from a flying kulhad suspend in the air, with individual glistening droplets visible. Tricolor confetti and marigold petals float motionless. Firecracker smoke hangs in frozen swirling clouds. People are frozen mid-cheer and mid-air in leaping embraces, some with faces painted in saffron, white, and green. Stadium floodlights catch the suspended dust, smoke, and liquid. Absolute silence. [0:06–0:09] Only he moves. His leather kohlapuris echo slightly on the concrete steps. The camera tracks backward as he walks through the frozen celebration, observing calmly with a slight royal smirk. He casually ducks under an arc of frozen, splashing chai from a floating kulhad. He notices a cluster of floating marigold petals and confetti, reaches out with precision, and plucks a single marigold petal from the air. [0:09–0:11] He stops in front of a frozen teenage boy wearing a Virat Kohli jersey, his face locked in an ecstatic, tearful scream, arms raised for a high-five, tricolor flag frozen mid-wave. The main character tilts his head, gently adjusts the frozen boy's India cap, nods slightly with approval, and softly says: "perfect." [0:11–0:15] He turns, tosses the marigold petal into his mouth, and crunches it. He faces the camera directly, smirks with that signature GovindAI confidence, and snaps again. A stronger reverse shockwave restores motion instantly. The chai completes its splash, the "India! India!" roar thunderously returns, firecrackers resume bursting, and fans land their jumps. He walks away into the celebrating Kolkata crowd as the camera pushes through the wildly jumping, flag-waving Eden Gardens audience. Fade to black. Sound: deafening Eden Gardens roar "India! India!" / firecrackers / celebration → snap → deep shockwave bass drop → absolute silence → leather kohlapuri footsteps on concrete → sharp marigold petal crunch → "perfect" → snap → reverse shockwave whoosh → deafening Eden Gardens celebration returns with full chaos.

prompts.text: Cinematic dark fantasy. A young woman stands before a glowing ornate oval mirror in a Victorian vanity room. The old woman reflected inside is not her reflection — she presses her wrinkled hands to the glass and begins absorbing the young woman's youth. Golden luminous energy flows from the girl into the mirror. The old woman's face rapidly de-ages — wrinkles vanish, hair darkens, eyes brighten — as she smiles with cold satisfaction. The young woman's skin turns ashen, she staggers, then collapses to the floor in slow motion, perfume bottles scattering. Final frame: the now-young mirror woman's hand pressed against glass, smiling down at the fallen girl. Slow dolly in → orbit around mirror → crash zoom out on collapse → extreme close-up on glass hand. Shallow DOF, warm amber light, desaturating victim, 35mm cinematic grain.

prompts.text: Seedance 2.0 video prompt THE SANDCASTLE Cinematic hyperlapse, 16:9, 15 seconds, photorealistic, beach golden-hour lighting, overhead and low-angle shots. [0:00–0:04] A man arrives at an empty beach at sunrise with a bucket, shovel, and inexplicable determination. Hyperlapse begins: he digs, packs, sculpts. The sun arcs overhead. What starts as a simple mound becomes a foundation. Then walls. Then towers. He's not building a sandcastle — he's building a sand FORTRESS. [0:04–0:08] The structure grows to absurd scale — six feet tall, twelve feet wide. Flying buttresses. A working drawbridge (made of popsicle sticks). A moat filled with actual seawater via a hand-dug canal. He sculpts individual sand bricks. He adds windows. He adds a flag (a napkin on a straw). Other beachgoers gather and watch in awe. He ignores them completely. [0:08–0:12] The final details. He carves a miniature throne room visible through the gate. He sculpts tiny sand soldiers on the battlements. He adds a sand dragon coiled around the tallest tower. He places seashells as decorative stonework. A crowd of 30 people is now watching, filming on their phones. He stands, surveys his masterpiece, sunburnt and exhausted. It's genuinely magnificent. He nods. Turns to the crowd. Takes a bow. [0:12–0:15] A seagull lands on the tallest tower. He shoos it. It doesn't move. He shoos harder. The seagull looks at him. Looks at the castle. Kicks the tower. The tower crumbles. The crumble triggers a chain reaction — the entire fortress collapses in a spectacular slow-motion avalanche of sand. EVERYTHING gone in four seconds. The crowd gasps. He stands in the rubble. The seagull flies away with the napkin flag. He watches it go. Sits down in the ruins. Picks up his bucket. "Same time tomorrow." Fade to black. Sound: waves/shovel digging → sand packing rhythm → crowd murmur building → camera shutter clicks → bow/crowd applause → seagull screech → sand crumbling (avalanche) → crowd "OHHH" → seagull wings → "same time tomorrow" → waves → silence.

prompts.text: Romantic drama. A handsome young gentleman and an elegant lady stand facing each other in the center of the room, tension thick in the air. The camera moves in with a slow, smooth medium shot as he looks straight into her eyes, breathing unsteadily and murmurs: “I wanted to tell you...”, he hesitates for a beat, fingers tightening around her hand, then suddenly snaps, half‐laughing at himself: “Oh, to hell with it,” and pulls her sharply into a passionate kiss. Cut to a close‐up: for a few seconds she responds to the kiss, hands clutching at his shoulders, eyes closed, overwhelmed — then her body slowly stiffens, she starts to pull away, breathing in short, broken breaths; she turns her head aside and, voice trembling but not loud, whispers: “Let me go.” He refuses to release her, one arm firm around her waist, the other holding her hand, pressing her closer, burying his face in her hair as he exhales against her ear, hoarse and desperate: “Don’t run from me.” Camera shifts into a tight close‐up on her face in profile: her eyes shining with unshed tears, a mix of pain, love and resolve. Victoria's Secret style: sensuality, luxury, glamour. Very detailed. She adjusts the straps of her massive feather wings, takes a deep breath, chest rising and falling. The crystals on her tight corset flash briefly under the emergency light. Camera: Steadicam following from behind, slight handheld shake, creating a documentary-style follow-shot feel. Lighting: Only a warm overhead work light illuminates the tips of her hair and the edges of the wings, her body hidden in darkness. 3-7s (Shot 2: Stepping Toward the Light) Scene: She begins to walk, accelerating from a slow pace to runway rhythm. The fluffy short skirt bounces with each step. The wings stir up fine dust, forming a stream of golden particles in the side backlight. Her face emerges from the shadows, eyes locked forward, the corners of her mouth rising into a confident Victoria’s Secret-style smile. Camera: Sideways tracking shot, keeping her in the golden ratio position of the frame as the background gradually brightens. Effects: Subtle physical trembling of the wing feathers, crisp hint of crystal beads colliding with each other. 7-12s (Shot 3: Flash Explosion) Scene: Dense camera flashes suddenly erupt ahead (simulating red carpet/photography area). Focus on emotional payoff over features. FORMAT: Ultra-realistic cinematic UGC video, 15–18 seconds, 24fps, vertical 9:16 Natural daylight, Mumbai apartment setting, soft lifestyle aesthetic CHARACTER: A young Indian woman in her late 20s–early 30s, relaxed, at-home look, seated by a window. Comfortable, relatable, no heavy makeup, natural smile. SCENE FLOW (CONTINUOUS — NO HARD CUTS IN SCRIPT PHASE): DIALOGUE (timed natural pacing ~16s): (soft exhale, slight smile) “Okay... I used to think I needed one of those fancy coffee machines to feel awake in the morning.” (light chuckle, shakes head slightly) “But honestly, most days I just don’t have the time... and I’d either skip it, or end up with something really average.” (slight pause, looks at cup, tone shifts — more certain) “Then I tried this... and it just made things easier.” (natural hand gesture, casual tone) “It’s literally a spoon, hot water... and somehow it still tastes like proper coffee.” (smiles, relaxed payoff) “Now it’s the one thing I actually look forward to before starting my day.” PERFORMANCE NOTES: Dialogue must feel unscripted, slightly imperfect, natural pauses allowed No overacting, no “ad voice” Subtle micro-expressions: smile, small head nods, eye movement toward cup Keep rhythm conversational, not rushed AUDIO: Clean voice, close mic feel Soft ambient room tone (light city + distant birds) No background music overpowering voice Optional very light warm instrumental at <15% volume VISUAL RULES: Natural handheld feel or soft tripod (UGC authenticity) Shallow depth of field, subject in focus, background softly blurred Warm color grading, slightly golden morning tones No on-screen text No hard product push yet (product reveal comes in scene breakdown phase)

prompts.text: Ark Short Trailer video prompt Cinematic short film, visual effects composition. 15-second epic trailer, 10 shots. [0–1.5s] TITLE CARD: "BEFORE THE RAIN" — white text on black. Drone descent — golden hour, impossibly vast wooden ark on cracked dry plain. One weathered, bearded man drives a peg into the hull. His family works alone. No one else believes. [1.5–4s] THE GATHERING. Crane descent into tracking follow. Two lions lead a column of animals stretching to the horizon — elephants, giraffes, wolves beside deer, eagles overhead. Every species walking in impossible peace. Dust from a thousand hooves. White doves land on Noah's outstretched arm. VO: "They called him mad." [4–5.5s] Rapid macro inserts: elephant foot stepping on wooden ramp, foxes curling in a hay stall, Noah's bloody-knuckled hand slamming the door bolt shut. [5.5–8s] TITLE CARD: "THE SKY WEPT FOR FORTY DAYS." Time-lapse — sky turns from amber to bruised purple-black. Clouds spiral. Lightning strikes. Rain begins — not drops, sheets. Walls of water. Camera starts UNDERWATER — submerged trees, buildings. Cranes up, breaks surface. The ark FLOATS. The world is ocean. Waves the size of cathedrals. Lightning strobes. [8–10s] Interior ark, firelight. Noah against the hull. Animal sounds everywhere. Water rushes past hull slats. He prays. [10–13s] VO: "And on the hundred and fiftieth day..." ECU — white dove returns with olive branch. First break in clouds. Golden god ray pierces the deck like a spotlight from heaven. [13–15s] The ark on a mountaintop. Water receding. Ramp lowers. Animals POUR OUT — birds explode in murmuration, elephants lumber, deer sprint. Noah silhouetted against sunrise. Camera rises. A rainbow stretches horizon to horizon. TITLE: "THE ARK." prompts.text: @Image1 is the main character — maintain consistent facial features and body type throughout. Appears only once per frame, no duplicates. Cinematic time-freeze short film, 15 seconds, ultra-realistic, Arri Alexa Mini shooting texture, 50mm lens, natural daylight hard shadows, shallow depth of field. [0:00–0:03] Busy Alpine village street — wooden chalet shopfronts, cobblestone ground, dramatic mountain peaks visible at the end of the lane, clear blue sky. Steadicam front-facing medium shot tracking: the main character — a young man with dark hair, black-framed glasses, light stubble, silver chain necklace, wearing a loose printed short-sleeve shirt — walks confidently through the tourist crowd. Hikers with backpacks, shop signs, a postcard rack outside a souvenir store. A pigeon cuts across the sky above him. He raises both hands, interlaces his fingers, and snaps. [0:03–0:06] A powerful white spherical shockwave bursts outward from his hands, carrying visible air distortion and light refraction, spreading in all directions. Pedestrians freeze mid-stride. The pigeon locks mid-flight overhead. Most strikingly — a street juggler beside the postcard shop freezes with three apples suspended mid-arc in the air above him, hanging perfectly still against the blue sky. Postcards fly off the rack and hang frozen in the air. Absolute silence falls over the village. [0:06–0:09] Only his footsteps echo off the cobblestones. He strolls casually along the frozen street, glancing around with calm satisfaction. He passes the frozen pigeon overhead, pays it no mind. He slows as he approaches the postcard rack — reaches up and plucks one of the floating, suspended postcards out of mid-air, turns it over in his hand, looks at it briefly with a raised eyebrow. Sets it back. Keeps walking. [0:09–0:11] He stops directly in front of the frozen juggler — three apples hanging perfectly mid-arc above the man's outstretched hands. He tilts his head, studies the composition. A slow smile. He looks at the camera, gives a small nod, and whispers "perfect." [0:11–0:15] He turns back to face the street, interlaces his hands and snaps again — a second shockwave, stronger, bursts outward in reverse. Everything unfreezes instantly: the juggler catches his apples and continues seamlessly, postcards flutter back to the rack, the pigeon flaps away, hikers resume mid-conversation. City noise and mountain ambience rush back in. He calmly turns and walks toward the camera. Camera slowly rises and pulls back — his silhouette moves down the Alpine lane between the chalets. Fade to black. Sound design: Alpine village ambience → double snap → shockwave rumble radiating outward → absolute silence → lone footsteps on cobblestone → whispered "perfect" → second snap → reverse shockwave burst → village sounds and mountain wind naturally restored.

prompts.text: Scene 1 Action: The creature from ref image steps through a shimmering, distorted dimensional portal into a dark, modern bedroom. Camera: Low-angle tracking shot following the creature's boots as it emerges from the rift. Lighting: High-contrast chiaroscuro with flickering cerulean light from the portal and deep cinematic shadows. Sound: Low-frequency atmospheric drone, electrical hum of the portal, and the metallic clink of heavy footsteps. Scene 2 Action: The creature approaches a sleeping man; as it raises a neon-gloved hand, all motion in the room suddenly freezes. Camera: Slow-motion push-in to a tight close-up on the creature’s reflective black mask, then panning to the man. Lighting: Dim moonlight from a window supplemented by a cold, clinical top-down rim light. Sound: Instant vacuum-like silence followed by a high-pitched, crystalline ringing representing the time freeze. Scene 3 Action: The creature touches the frozen man’s shoulder, and both begin to dematerialize into glowing particles. Camera: Extreme close-up of the neon glove against the man's skin, followed by a rapid 360-degree orbital rotation. Lighting: Ethereal glow from the creature's gloves, casting a sickly green hue over the subject. Sound: Granular synthesis effects, shimmering digital "glitch" sounds, and a deep, resonant sub-bass pulse. Scene 4 Action: The bedroom is suddenly empty; the portal collapses into a single point of light before vanishing entirely. Camera: Wide static shot of the empty room, slowly zooming out to emphasize the sudden vacuum and isolation. prompts.text: Decided to save some credits on Seedance 2.0 by going with 7 seconds. Bad idea. 7 seconds is just not enough to show anything these days. 😅 Epic cinematic storm-fantasy sequence on a cliffside monastery above a violent sea at night. A colossal sea titan made of black water, broken ship hulls, and bioluminescent eyes rises beside the cliffs during a lightning storm. Phase 1: immense build-up. Bells swing in gale force wind, monks run across stone bridges carrying lanterns, waves detonate against the lower walls, and the titan’s outline slowly assembles from the ocean itself. The camera is unstable, fighting the wind, whipping between terrified faces and the impossible form rising in fragments. Phase 2: catastrophic event. The titan lifts one arm the size of a tower and brings it down onto the outer seawall. Stone explodes outward. A bridge collapses. Lantern fire scatters into the rain. The camera is thrown sideways, briefly losing the horizon as debris and spray consume the frame. Phase 3: sudden subtraction. All sound drops to a low muffled underwater tone. Rain still falls, but softly. The camera, once chaotic, now drifts in a slow stabilized move through the aftermath: broken prayer flags hanging still, scattered embers hissing out in puddles, stunned monks kneeling in silence, fragments of blue bioluminescence sliding back down the shattered stones toward the sea. Detail priority: cracked masonry, rain threading off eaves, lantern glass fragments, trembling hands, luminous seawater retreating through carved channels, distant thunder now far away. Ending: the titan is gone. On the broken edge of the monastery, a single giant wet handprint glows faintly on the stone before fading. Final wide shot at dawn: the ruined cliff temple overlooks a suddenly calm sea.

Prompt:

A hyper-realistic, experimental cinematic sequence set within an endless, monochrome void. The only objects visible are millions of suspended, geometric glass sculptures of varying shapes—spheres, polyhedrons, shattered shards. The void isn't black; it’s an oppressive, flat greyscale that devours depth. Suddenly, the void itself cracks. It’s a fissure not in a wall, but in the texture of space, emitting a deafening sound like shattering ceramic.

Emerging violently from this cosmic fracture is a massive Origami Kraken, constructed entirely from sentient, folding geometric paper that is constantly shifting and reconfiguring its shape. The Kraken doesn't just swim; its movement causes the air to instantly crystalize into jagged, impossible architectures.

Perched upon the Kraken's head is a Gothic-Industrial Painter, covered in a suit of canvas and leather straps. Instead of paint, their "brush" is a high-powered plasma welder. As the Kraken moves, the Painter isn't just surviving; they are actively forging impossible geometries using molten light, welding new, glowing structures onto the Kraken’s body, causing portions of the origami creature to shift from paper to a complex, transparent glass and light mesh.

The Twist:
As the Kraken roars—a sound of folding metal—the monochrome void violently inverts. The shadows become blinding white, and the glass sculptures begin to reflect a universe of previously unseen, chaotic, non-Euclidean colors (colors that shouldn’t exist, like "dark neon" or "glowing shadow").

Suddenly, a localized reality distortion occurs: a swarm of Vantablack hummingbirds manifests. These creatures aren’t biological; they are actual, kinetic shadows that absorb all light, launching from the monochrome distortions to attack the painter and the Kraken. The camera perspective performs a disorienting 90-degree whip-pan shift, turning the horizontal movement into a vertical free-fall, following the painter as they leap from the Kraken's head, dodging the Vantablack hummingbirds, using their plasma welder to create temporary, glowing shields of light that disintegrate the shadow-creatures mid-flight. The painter is diving toward the fractal-shifted glass-light mesh of the Kraken’s body.

Lighting & Atmosphere:
The scene is a claustrophobic paradox. The initial lighting is a severe, high-contrast monochrome (grey, black, white), which is suddenly and violently interrupted by the impossible colors (colors that shift and glow in ways physics doesn't allow) from the Kraken's new structure and the inverted void. The main light source shifts from a flat grey to the intense, localized ultraviolet and neon-orange radiance of the plasma welder.

Audio Profile:
The sound begins with a deafening, low-frequency grinding of the void cracking. The Kraken’s movements are marked by the high-pitched, mechanical screeching of shifting origami paper. When the Vantablack hummingbirds launch, the audio shifts to a unique sound: a mix of silent compression and static hiss. A frantic, experimental glitch-orchestral score (strings distorted by digital noise) builds to the void inversion. The plasma welder ignites with a high-pitched, electric whine, cutting to absolute sonic stillness as the camera dips below the inverted void's horizon, leaving only the faint, melodic resonance of the Impossible Colors.

prompts.text: Behind the scenes of a location shoot somewhere in the Caribbean using my avatar 📸☀️🌴🐚🐠 Using Seedance 2 on @freepik Try it! Prompt 👇 Low wide-angle camera, 24mm lens, starting position directly in front of the scene at chest height. A photographer stands left of frame camera raised to eye, a tall model in a flowing coral-terracotta gown stands centre frame on coastal rocks, a male assistant crouches low right of centre holding a large reflector, a clothing rack and octabox light stand stand far right. Deep turquoise sea behind them, blue sky, golden hour light from the right. All four subjects are completely frozen in time like statues — rigid, motionless, not a single micro-movement. The model's dress is caught mid-billow toward the sea. A wave is frozen mid-rise on the rocks behind the model, white water suspended in the air. Sea spray particles hang completely motionless in the golden light. Everything is absolutely still — frozen like a photograph. The camera performs a smooth steady counter-clockwise 360-degree orbit around the entire scene at constant low height and constant speed, wide enough to keep all people and equipment visible throughout the full rotation. All subjects remain completely rigid during the entire orbit — frozen like statues, no movement whatsoever, no breathing, no swaying. The orbit reveals the frozen wave from behind, the frozen dress from all angles, the suspended sea spray catching golden light. Exactly when the camera completes its full 360-degree orbit and returns to its original front-facing position — time releases instantly and explosively. The wave crashes powerfully on the rocks behind the model. The dress drops and swirls. The hair falls. The photographer fires the camera — a single instantaneous flash of light, gone immediately. Everything roars back to life simultaneously. Warm amber highlights, cool teal ocean shadows, subtle film grain. Cinematic, photorealistic, ultra sharp. No debris, no particles flying through air, no hallucinations. Sound: near-silence during orbit — low eerie hum. Release: explosive wave crash, sea wind returning, single camera flash pop. No music.

A photographer stands left of frame camera raised to eye, a tall model in a flowing coral-terracotta gown stands centre frame on coastal rocks, a male assistant crouches low right of centre holding a large reflector, a clothing rack and octabox light stand stand far right. Deep turquoise sea behind them, blue sky, golden hour light from the right. All four subjects are completely frozen in time like statues — rigid, motionless, not a single micro-movement. The model's dress is caught mid-billow toward the sea. A wave is frozen mid-rise on the rocks behind the model, white water suspended in the air. Sea spray particles hang completely motionless in the golden light. Everything is absolutely still — frozen like a photograph.

All subjects remain completely rigid during the entire orbit — frozen like statues, no movement whatsoever, no breathing, no swaying. The orbit reveals the frozen wave from behind, the frozen dress from all angles, the suspended sea spray catching golden light.

The wave crashes powerfully on the rocks behind the model. The dress drops and swirls. The hair falls. The photographer fires the camera — a single instantaneous flash of light, gone immediately. Everything roars back to life simultaneously.

prompts.text: [CINEMATIC SETUP] Film Style: Photorealistic 8K, 65mm IMAX. One continuous forward dolly — no cuts. Landscape transforms around a steadily advancing camera as if walking through 10,000 years. Lens: 24mm wide-angle, shallow horizon. Color Grade: Ochre to blood-red to emerald to gold to steel-blue, each era bleeding into the next. Lighting: Golden hour shifting to overcast to firelight to electric — the light itself ages with civilization. Camera: Constant slow forward dolly at chest height. No lateral movement, no tilt. [TIMELINE — CONTINUOUS FORWARD DOLLY] 0-2s: RIVER VALLEY. Glide over cracked mud beside the Tigris. Mud-brick walls rise on both sides in accelerated construction. An irrigation channel fills with brown water. Grain stalks shoot to full height. 2-4s: WARFARE. Mud walls crumble and reform as stone fortifications. Fields scorch black. Bronze spearheads jut from the ground. A watchtower assembles ahead then fractures as the camera passes through dust. 4-6s: AFRICAN EMPIRES. Dust clears to red laterite soil. Gold trade goods glint in market stalls assembling as camera passes. A Great Zimbabwe stone wall curves into view, dry-stacked blocks fitting together. Baobab trees grow from saplings to full canopy. 6-8s: SOUTH AMERICA. Laterite morphs to grey Andean stone. Inca terraces step upward on both sides greening with crops. Stone steps assemble beneath the path. A temple facade emerges — carved faces forming from rough rock. 8-10s: INDUSTRIAL. Stone becomes cobblestone. Brick factories replace timber buildings. A rail track lays itself down the center path. Smokestacks grow, emitting pale plumes. Gas lamps ignite in sequence. 10-13s: MODERN. Cobblestone becomes asphalt. Glass towers rise on both sides. Headlight streaks blur past. Neon signage illuminates. Contrails scratch across the sky. More glass, more light, more vertical. 13-15s: LAUNCH. Towers fall away. Open concrete ahead. A rocket on a launch pad. Ignition — white exhaust erupts downward. The rocket rises out of frame. Camera advances into dissipating exhaust revealing black sky and stars. [QUALITY] Photorealistic 8K. Each era architecturally distinct — mud, stone, brick, steel, glass. Transformations bridge through shared shapes: walls become walls, roads become roads. No duplicates. Consistent forward momentum. Gradual lighting transitions.

完整提示词（一个字未改，直接复制可用）：

【@图1】的服饰为初始形象，脸部和头发换成【@图2】中的人物形象。比例 16:9，总时长 10s。画面以 Diagonal Low-angle Medium Close-up（对角线低仰角近景） 开场。 上半身侧探入画面，头部位于左侧。右手食指与中指仅夹住一张单牌侧面横跨画面中心，眼神 Stoic（坚忍冷静），面部呈现 Laser-focused（激光般专注）的 Minimalist（极简）神态。 

0s - 2s (开场动能：冷静的物理操纵)： 0.8s 时手腕轻微转动，使这张孤立的牌面翻转展示出红色背面，以此动能为锚点触发镜头回正并执行平滑 Dolly Out 展示中景走廊的冷白矩阵光与高光泽地板。 

2s - 4.5s (空间拉伸与单牌弧线轨迹)：主角双手旋转该（唯一单牌1.5）后向两侧平稳移开（Hands move apart without any throwing motion），该单张扑克牌像被磁力吸引般，以其中心点为轴心，执行平行于地面的高速水平自旋（High-speed horizontal axis-spin），并沿平肩高度执行从右向左的水平半圆弧形轨迹。严禁出现粒子喷射感，严禁牌向镜头方向（Z轴）飞行，空间中绝对禁止出现第二张牌的像素残影（Absolutely zero extra card particles）。与此同时，镜头快速拉远至全景，将视角中心完全留给这张孤立旋转的单牌轨迹。 

4.5s - 6s (运镜反弹与接牌蓄力)： 镜头借由单牌惯性极速推进（Dolly In），锁回主体。伸左手精准接住这张唯一的单牌并回收手关节蓄力。此时整个物理空间仍保持“单牌真空”状态。 

6s - 7s (遮挡转场：从现实到舞台的临界点)： 向镜头正面展示牌面，镜头以牌面为聚焦锚点执行指数级加速冲刺，在 5.5s 时牌面完全占据画面 100% 形成物理遮挡锚点，实现空间阻断。 

7s - 10s (身份变异与魅惑定格)： 牌面划开瞬间，丝滑转场至红裙猫耳形象，画面瞬切为 Ultra-wide angle 14mm 强透视构图。位于画面中心，面部表情转变为 Alluring（魅惑）与 Authoritative gaze（权威凝视），带着 Sultry smirk（性感的冷笑）和 Dominant elegance（掌控的优雅）。主角左手五指张开呈直指镜头的贯穿式动态，手掌由于透视极其巨大，形成破屏感，身体微微后仰。此时背景已切换为深色幕布与金色雕花画框，顶部强逆光在主体猫耳及银发边缘勾勒出锐利的轮廓光边线，红裙材质在侧光下呈现深邃的明暗梯度。多枚扑克牌作为前景失焦元素慢速旋转，产生撕裂般的空间深度。主体右手食指轻触下颌，目光锁定镜头，画面最终定格在电影级纵深感极强的华丽姿态。

prompts.text: Ultra-photorealistic cinematic desert sci-fi scene, using the provided image as the starting frame. A vast, harsh desert stretches outward with natural sand formations, fine granular detail, and visible heat distortion near the ground. A lone armored figure is actively running across the dune, not posing — full sprint, kicking up sand with each step, body leaning forward under force, arms pumping naturally. prompts.text: hyper-realistic, cinematic 8K scene capturing a violent ontological breach in a modern art gallery. A classical oil painting of a naval battle undergoes a catastrophic physical manifestation: a massive rogue wave detonates from the canvas, shattering the ornate golden frame into shrapnel and flooding the sterile gallery with churning, three-dimensional water. A massive tall ship charges through the breach, its bowsprit pulverizing a marble sculpture as it enters reality. On the ship’s deck, cannons fire vivid orange flashes, emitting volumetric smoke that blends with the gallery’s diffused track lighting. The scene emphasizes chaotic action: adjacent paintings are ripped from walls by sudden gale-force winds, and a modern chandelier is torn from the ceiling by the ship's rigging in a shower of sparks and plaster dust. The polished gallery floor becomes a swirling whirlpool, dragging benches and pedestals into the current. Cinematography & Technicals: Shot with a virtual Arri Alexa Mini LF, 50mm prime lens. The camera begins with a suspenseful slow push-in that transitions into a violent, handheld shake and rapid snap-zoom during the breach, followed by a low-angle tracking shot skimming the water. Lighting & Color: The clean, sterile lighting of the gallery shorts out upon water contact, replaced by strobe-like electrical sparks, flickering warm ship lanterns, and the dramatic, high-contrast glow of painted lightning from the emerging storm clouds. Rendering: Path-traced global illumination with advanced fluid dynamics for the breaching rogue wave. 60fps frame rate (conformed to 24fps) to capture the splintering wood and oil-slicked water droplets in cinematic slow-motion. PBR materials for the cracked oil texture of the sails, the polished gallery floor, and the splintering gilded wood.

Digital elements feel physical — weight, resistance, light spill. Color palette: warm market tones (fabric stalls, skin, sunlight) contrasted with cool digital screen glow. Hyper-detailed textures: screen glare, fingerprints, fabric weave, subtle dust in air. MOTION Shot 1 — Establish Market Energy 35mm handheld — crowded street market, people moving in all directions. Camera weaving through bodies, slightly obstructed view, natural chaos. Digital screen stands among stalls — vertical, clean, out of place. Shot 2 — Approach + Interaction Camera settles as she steps into frame. Medium shot — she pauses in front of the screen. Subtle curiosity, not exaggerated. She lifts her hand and scrolls — screen reacts instantly with smooth UI motion. Shot 3 — Dress Appears Close on screen — a dress rotates slowly, fabric simulation realistic, light catching folds. Her reflection faintly visible on glass surface. She pauses scroll. Hand hovers. Shot 4 — Pull Through Moment (Hero Action) She reaches forward — fingers touch screen surface. There’s slight resistance — like pushing into liquid glass. Fingers pass through. She grips the dress fabric and pulls it outward — fabric emerges from screen with weight and drag. Screen surface distorts slightly around her arm. Camera moves closer instinctively, slight shake — reacting to the impossibility. Shot 5 — Instant Wear Transition As she pulls the dress fully out — quick motion across her body. Seamless transformation: Current outfit transitions into the pulled dress mid-motion — not a flash cut, but a continuous morph tied to fabric movement. Cloth settles naturally on her body — gravity, folds, tension all realistic. Shot 6 — Screen Aftermath Cut to screen — now blank. Only faint glow, subtle reflections of market behind. No UI, no content — completely empty. Shot 7 — Walk Away (Fashion Beat) She turns and walks into the market wearing the dress. Camera follows briefly — people pass, no one reacts. Fabric moves naturally with her steps — wind interaction, slight friction sounds. Shot 8 — Loop Closure Beat Camera drifts back to the screen as another passerby steps in. Hand reaches toward the blank display. Just before touch — frame aligns compositionally with earlier interaction moment. AUDIO Market ambience: chatter, footsteps, vendors calling, distant traffic. Screen interaction: soft digital hum, subtle tactile “pressure” sound when hand enters. Fabric pull: light tension + release sound. After transformation: ambience returns fully, grounding the moment. No music initially. Light ambient tone fades in during transformation — subtle, not cinematic. CAMERA 35mm / 50mm handheld Natural human movement — slight imperfections always present Push-ins motivated by curiosity, not perfection No overly smooth gimbal feel Transitions driven by action (hand movement, fabric pull, body turn) FRAME RATE 24fps, natural motion blur. LIGHTING Late afternoon market light — warm, slightly directional. Digital screen emits cool, soft glow that reflects on her skin during interaction. Post-transformation: lighting returns fully natural. SUBJECT Confident but grounded. Reacts minimally — curiosity > shock. Movement clean, intentional — fashion presence without over-performance. PROP — DIGITAL SCREEN Slim vertical display, slightly worn edges (not futuristic perfection). Glass surface shows fingerprints, smudges. When interacted with: behaves like a flexible membrane — subtle distortion, not sci-fi flashy.
